raw.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Sr. Experiential Event Manager

The Role

We are seeking a Senior Experiential Event Manager to lead the execution and optimization of high-impact, data-driven field and event marketing programs. This role is designed for an experienced experiential marketing professional with 8 to 12 years of expertise in live, virtual, and hybrid events who excels at translating business objectives into measurable experience outcomes.

Reporting to the VP of ABX, this role serves as a senior individual contributor responsible for the execution and measurable performance of experiential marketing programs. The Senior Experiential Event Manager will ensure events are not standalone moments, but structured, accountable programs that create meaningful engagement and contribute directly to pipeline outcomes.

This role is critical to how 6sense engages strategic accounts and buying groups through high-quality, insight-driven experiences that generate measurable business impact.

The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with strong analytical skills and a deep understanding of how experiences influence buying groups and accelerate sales cycles.

You will bring a clear point of view on what great experiential field marketing looks like, influence strategy, and deliver programs that drive measurable business outcomes.

The Fit

We push the envelope. We move fast and innovate. We put prospect and customer experience at the center of everything we do.

Details matter, so if excellent attention to detail and a passion for delivering amazing experiences is your thing, join us.

You should love working with marketing and sales leaders to discover where we can innovate to deliver superior experiences. You should be passionate about creating quick wins and taking programs from "good enough" to "really good."

We use great technology, especially our own. You should be a technology enthusiast, willing to try new things, and be on the leading edge of what is possible. You can pivot quickly when business priorities change. You are a high-energy, self-starting performer who stays on top of what needs to get done and motivates others to make things happen.

Responsibilities

Experience Design & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end planning and execution of executive events, field programs, and experiential activations that support revenue objectives.
  • Design audience-centric experiences grounded in data, clear messaging, and defined business outcomes using 6sense.
  • Ensure seamless delivery across in-person, virtual, and hybrid formats with consistent brand and operational standards.
  • Translate GTM priorities into structured, measurable event programs with defined KPIs.

Strategic Events & Experiences

  • Support flagship, executive-level, and high-value field and corporate events from concept through execution.
  • Ensure events are fully integrated into broader ABX and GTM campaigns, not standalone moments.
  • Drive intentional program design focused on audience, messaging, outcomes, and ROI.
  • Oversee vendor, partner, and venue relationships while maintaining strong budget discipline.

Pipeline Ownership & Enablement

  • Collaborate closely with sales leadership, revenue marketing, and field teams to align events to priority accounts and buying groups.
  • Support account-level targeting and pre-event outreach strategies.
  • Ensure structured post-event follow-up processes are in place to drive engagement, acceleration, and measurable pipeline contribution.
  • Act as a proactive partner to sales by providing visibility into performance metrics and engagement insights.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Work closely with ABX, product marketing, demand generation, content, growth, and marketing operations teams.
  • Influence without authority by providing clear direction, frameworks, and expertise.
  • Share learnings and best practices across regions to help scale what works.

Operational Excellence

  • Manage event budgets with strong financial discipline and ROI accountability.
  • Oversee vendor, partner, and venue relationships to ensure quality, consistency, and cost efficiency.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and cross-functional coordination across marketing, content, product, and operations teams.
  • Leverage marketing technology and data platforms to enhance targeting, registration quality, and attendee engagement tracking.

Requirements

  • 8 to 12 years of experience in field marketing and event marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Deep expertise in ABM/ABX and field marketing strategy and execution.
  • Proven success driving pipeline and revenue impact through events and field programs.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with senior leaders.
  • Experience partnering closely with sales and GTM teams.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven with the ability to translate results into insights.
  • Strong project management, budgeting, and vendor management skills.
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Hands-on, proactive, and accountable with a strong ownership mindset.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, 6sense, and related marketing technology platforms preferred.

Base Salary Range: $101,275.50 - $148,537.40. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

raw.description:
The Tax Specialist is responsible for processing payroll and sales-related business taxes across federal, state, and local jurisdictions while ensuring compliance with applicable tax laws and regulatory requirements. This role researches and resolves tax issues, manages tax notices and agency correspondence, performs tax reconciliations and data validation, and ensures accurate and timely tax filings and payments. The Tax Specialist analyzes trends, identifies root causes of tax issues, and recommends process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and compliance. Success in this role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while consistently delivering accurate results and meeting regulatory deadlines. The Tax Specialist collaborates effectively with internal teams and government agencies to provide exceptional service and support operational excellence.

We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role.

Who are we?

Back Office, a Buyers Edge Platform Software solution, dismantles siloed restaurant technology systems by bringing Accounting, AP Automation, Bookkeeping, Food Cost Management, and Payroll together in one unified tech stack. Developed by restaurant operators for restaurant operators, Back Office goes beyond traditional software; it’s powered by industry experts who guide users to make faster, data-driven decisions around revenue, cost of goods, labor, and compliance. Through intuitive technology and continuous education, independent, multi-location, franchise, and enterprise restaurant groups gain actionable insights to drive smarter operations and stronger profitability. At the heart of our work is a culture built on a passion for collaboration, technology, and helping foodservice business succeed.

Your impact:

Tax Filing & Processing:

  • Process payroll and sales-related business tax filings accurately and timely across all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictions.
  • Prepare and process original, amended, and delinquent tax returns and associated tax payments.

Tax Notice Research & Resolution:

  • Research tax notices and liaise with appropriate tax agencies for clarification and resolution.
  • Investigate tax discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Process amended returns, payment corrections, account reconciliations, and agency adjustments as necessary.
  • Document findings, resolutions, and preventative actions to improve future processing accuracy.

Research & Compliance:

  • Research federal, state, and local payroll and sales tax laws to ensure continued compliance.
  • Recommend updates to internal procedures to support ongoing compliance and operational excellence.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Participate in automation initiatives and implementation of new technologies that enhance tax operations.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives through documentation, testing, and process refinement.

Performance & Service Excellence

  • Deliver exceptional customer service through timely, professional, and accurate communication.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal departments to resolve client and operational issues.

About you:

  • Strong ability to identify issues and resolve problems in a timely and efficient manner, ensuring compliance and accuracy.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills when interacting with clients, agencies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Proficiency using payroll systems, tax software, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, prioritize tasks, and self-start projects, ensuring deadlines are met without supervision.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively within a collaborative team environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of state employment tax, sales tax, and federal/state tax laws, with the ability to apply this knowledge in a business context.
  • Demonstrated experience processing federal, state, and local payroll tax filings and payments across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while managing multiple priorities with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Strong customer service experience with the ability to communicate professionally with clients, government agencies, and internal stakeholders.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in payroll tax, sales tax, or a related tax compliance role.

Don’t meet every requirement mentioned here?

Studies have shown that women, communities of color and historically underrepresented talent are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Buyers Edge Platform and our subsidiary brands, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we strongly encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this position or others with us!

We welcome all.

We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

raw.description:
The Senior Security Operations Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and improving Data Loss Prevention (DLP) protections across Included Health's corporate and cloud environments. You will lead hands-on deployment and tuning of DLP controls, including endpoint, network, and SaaS. You will investigate and respond to potential data exfiltration events. Additionally, you will drive remediation and hardening based on real-world incidents and detections.

You will own the operational lifecycle of our DLP stack. It involves building and refining policies, partnering with stakeholders to validate business-safe controls, automating response playbooks, and turning signals from alerts and logs into durable security improvements. You will also contribute to adjacent security operations functions, including incident response and vulnerability management, where they intersect with data protection.

You will play a crucial role within the Security Engineering team, reporting directly to the Senior Manager, Security Engineering. This is a remote role.

Responsibilities:

    • Lead the response to DLP and data security incidents, including investigation, containment, remediation, and root cause analysis for suspected data exfiltration or improper data handling.

    • Own the deployment, configuration, and continuous tuning of DLP controls across endpoints, network egress, SaaS applications, and cloud storage to protect PHI, PII, PCI, and other sensitive data.

    • Develop and maintain DLP policies, rules, and classifications that balance security, usability, and regulatory/client requirements.

    • Build and refine automated response playbooks and workflows that enrich, triage, and respond to alerts, reducing manual effort and mean time to respond.

    • Perform proactive hunting for anomalous data movement, including unusual destinations, channels, or volumes.

    • Define and track key DLP metrics (coverage, detection quality, MTTD/MTTR, false positive rate) and communicate progress to security leadership and cross-functional partners.

Qualifications:

    • Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, or security engineering roles, with a strong emphasis on data protection and DLP.

    • Direct, hands-on experience deploying, tuning, and operating

      • DLP tools (endpoint, network, SaaS, and/or cloud)

      • Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) or similar SaaS security controls in a production environment.

      • DLP signals into SIEM/SOAR workflows (e.g., CrowdStrike, Splunk, Sentinel)

      • Advanced scripting/automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell, KQL/SQL) used to enrich, tune, and report on DLP/IR telemetry at scale.

      • Experience designing and maintaining data classification and policy frameworks for PHI, PII, PCI, and other sensitive data types.

The United States new hire base salary target ranges for this full-time position are:
Zone A: $128,130 - $180,990+ equity + benefits
Zone B: $140,943 - $199,089 + equity + benefits
Zone C: $153,756 - $217,188 + equity + benefits
Zone D: $166,569 - $235,287 + equity + benefits

Location: Remote. Darien Advisors considers qualified professionals globally in locations where the firm can lawfully establish a working relationship.

Opportunity Type: Ongoing opportunity. The final structure will depend on the selected candidate’s experience, availability, location, and the firm’s evolving needs.

Compensation: $80,000 to $150,000 annual equivalent. Actual compensation and structure will depend on experience, credentials, availability, scope, and final role design.

About the Opportunity

Darien Advisors is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to oversee client-accounting delivery across a growing portfolio of traditional and digital-asset businesses.

This opportunity is designed for someone who can bring structure to complex accounting engagements, review the work of others, manage competing deadlines, and maintain clear communication with clients and internal contributors.

The right candidate will combine strong technical accounting knowledge with practical leadership and sound judgment. They should be comfortable moving between detailed accounting issues and broader portfolio oversight while identifying risks, resolving bottlenecks, and ensuring deliverables meet the firm’s quality standards.

About Darien Advisors

Darien Advisors is a crypto-native tax, accounting, and strategic advisory firm serving investors, founders, and digital-asset businesses.

Our work sits at the intersection of traditional financial operations and the evolving digital-asset economy. We help clients organize complex financial activity, reconcile transactions across wallets and platforms, maintain accurate books and records, meet reporting obligations, and make informed decisions with greater clarity.

Our services include:

  1. Client accounting and financial reporting
  2. Month-end and year-end close support
  3. Cryptocurrency transaction reconciliation
  4. Individual and entity tax preparation
  5. Federal, state, and international tax compliance
  6. Tax planning and strategic advisory
  7. IRS and state-agency resolution
  8. Backlog cleanup and amended filings
  9. Accounting support for digital-asset businesses

We are a fully remote firm that values sound judgment, clear communication, accountability, and the ability to work effectively through complexity.

What You Will Do

  1. Oversee accounting delivery across an assigned portfolio of clients
  2. Coordinate month-end and year-end close processes, reconciliations, reporting, and related deliverables
  3. Review balance sheets, income statements, general ledgers, journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting workpapers
  4. Evaluate the completeness and accuracy of accounting records and identify matters requiring correction, clarification, or escalation
  5. Review work completed by accounting team members and provide clear, actionable feedback
  6. Monitor deadlines, priorities, capacity, and outstanding client information across assigned engagements
  7. Serve as a primary point of coordination for assigned clients and maintain clear communication regarding deliverables, open items, and timelines
  8. Support the onboarding and transition of new accounting clients
  9. Work with tax and advisory professionals to ensure accounting records support broader client needs
  10. Help resolve complex cleanup matters involving incomplete records, historical inconsistencies, multiple entities, or digital-asset activity
  11. Protect confidential client and firm information in accordance with applicable contractual and security requirements
  12. Identify recurring issues and recommend practical improvements to templates, workflows, documentation, and quality-control processes
  13. Help shape scalable accounting workflows and service-delivery standards as the firm grows

What We Are Looking For

  1. At least six years of progressive accounting experience
  2. At least two years of experience reviewing accounting work, managing client portfolios, or coordinating accounting teams
  3. Strong experience with month-end close, reconciliations, journal entries, financial reporting, and general-ledger management
  4. Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial-reporting requirements applicable to assigned clients
  5. Experience managing multiple client engagements, deadlines, and competing priorities
  6. Ability to review accounting records critically and identify errors, unsupported balances, missing information, and process gaps
  7. Experience with cloud-based accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online or Xero
  8. Strong written communication and the ability to explain accounting matters clearly and constructively
  9. Professional judgment when handling incomplete information, sensitive matters, or competing priorities
  10. Ability to coordinate work effectively within a remote environment
  11. A secure and reliable working environment appropriate for handling confidential information

Preferred Experience

  1. CPA, CA, ACCA, or another relevant accounting credential
  2. Experience within an accounting, advisory, outsourced finance, or client-services firm
  3. Experience managing accounting services for multiple entities or complex client portfolios
  4. Experience reviewing or supporting the work of distributed accounting teams
  5. Experience with accounting cleanup, process improvement, or client transitions
  6. Familiarity with cryptocurrency or other digital-asset accounting
  7. Familiarity with wallets, exchanges, stablecoins, DeFi, staking, token activity, or other onchain transactions
  8. Familiarity with Karbon or another practice-management platform
  9. Experience with technology, startup, professional-services, or digital-asset clients

Direct digital-asset accounting experience is preferred. At minimum, candidates should be willing and able to develop fluency in the accounting and documentation challenges associated with digital assets.

Systems We Use

  1. QuickBooks Online
  2. Xero
  3. Puzzle and Campfire, where applicable
  4. Karbon
  5. Slack
  6. Google Workspace
  7. Cryptocurrency subledger and reconciliation platforms based on client needs

Why Darien Advisors

  1. Oversee meaningful accounting work for growing and technically complex businesses
  2. Work at the intersection of traditional accounting and the digital-asset economy
  3. Join a modern, remote, and technology-supported advisory practice
  4. Apply both technical expertise and operational judgment
  5. Contribute directly to client outcomes and service quality
  6. Help strengthen accounting workflows as the firm continues to grow
  7. Collaborate with professionals who value clarity, ownership, and thoughtful problem-solving
  8. Be considered for expanded responsibilities as the firm’s needs evolve

What We Value

  1. Clear and timely communication
  2. Transparency when facts, documentation, or conclusions are uncertain
  3. Independent judgment and accountability
  4. Decisions grounded in the client’s best interests and applicable accounting requirements
  5. Curiosity and continued learning
  6. Respectful and practical collaboration
  7. Comfort working in a remote environment
  8. A willingness to engage thoughtfully with digital-asset complexity

Equal Opportunity

Darien Advisors welcomes qualified professionals from diverse backgrounds. Selection decisions are based on relevant qualifications, experience, business needs, and professional fit without unlawful discrimination.

How to Apply

Initial conversations will be conducted through Zoom or Google Meet.

Interested candidates should submit:

  1. A current resume or professional profile
  2. Relevant licenses or credentials
  3. A summary of accounting and client-service experience
  4. A summary of experience managing client portfolios, accounting teams, or close processes
  5. Details regarding QuickBooks Online, Xero, or comparable accounting-system proficiency
  6. Any relevant digital-asset accounting experience
  7. General availability and location

Applicants may omit or redact age, date of birth, and dates of attendance or graduation from submitted application materials.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the opportunity is filled. Selected candidates will receive additional information regarding the anticipated responsibilities, reporting relationships, compensation structure, and working arrangement before moving forward.

Salary: $80,000-$150,000

raw.description:
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. A companhia impulsiona a transformação digital de grandes empresas habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis, possibilitando assim que seus clientes ofereçam produtos e experiências digitais a todo o seu ecossistema.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.
Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Conheça + em nosso site:


Qual a missão do Cargo?

Manter de pé, observável e previsível a plataforma que sustenta as operações de Soluções Open em produção. É um ambiente multi-tenant, em cloud (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform), onde indisponibilidade não é inconveniente operacional — é descumprimento de obrigação regulatória, com janela de reporte e prazo definidos por regulador. O desafio central é deslocar a operação de reativa para preventiva: construir observabilidade que antecipe problema em vez de constatá-lo depois, e eliminar por automação o trabalho manual repetitivo. A pessoa nesta posição irá responder pelas soluções Open atuando junto de arquitetos cloud e de software, além de desenvolvedores, com responsabilidade compartilhada pelo que está no ar.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Observabilidade e monitoração: Construir e evoluir a monitoração dos ambientes de produção, com foco em antecipar falha; Definir e instrumentar indicadores que representem experiência real de uso, não apenas saúde de recurso; Reduzir ruído de alerta e falso positivo; Manter dashboards que sustentem decisão técnica.
  • Automação e redução de toil: Identificar e eliminar trabalho manual repetitivo: provisionamento, configuração, rotinas operacionais; Evoluir infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Helm) como fonte única de verdade; Desenvolver scripts e automações em Python e Shell para operações recorrentes; Converter procedimento não documentado em runbook executável.
  • Sustentação e resposta a incidente: Atuar na triagem, mitigação e resolução de incidentes de produção; Documentar e apoiar post-mortem com foco em causa raiz e ação preventiva; Sustentar os ambientes junto do time de engenharia; Acompanhar consumo e custo de infraestrutura, gerando visibilidade para decisão técnica

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

Experiência demonstrável, não familiaridade conceitual:

  • Ter operado Kubernetes em produção: debug de pod, análise de consumo de recurso, entendimento de modos de falha Cloud em ambiente de missão crítica — AWS preferencialmente
  • Ter escrito e mantido infraestrutura como código com Terraform e Helm, incluindo revisão de mudança de outra pessoa
  • Ter construído monitoração com Prometheus e Grafana: criação de métrica e regra de alerta, não apenas consumo de dashboard pronto
  • Troubleshooting em Linux com autonomia: serviços, processos, rede, disco, análise de log
  • Automações em Python ou Shell que outras pessoas passaram a usar
  • Participação em resposta a incidente de produção, com clareza sobre quando resolver e quando escalar
  • Conhecimento de rede suficiente para investigar: segmentação, DNS, TLS, VPN, ferramentas de debug

Quais serão os requisitos diferencias para este cargo?

  • Experiência em ambiente regulado: financeiro, seguros ou similar
  • Vivência com APIs, REST e gateway de API
  • Gerenciamento de logs em escala (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Loki ou equivalente)
  • Construção e manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD
  • Prática de definição de SLI e SLO, e uso de error budget para orientar decisão
  • Configuração como código (Ansible ou equivalente) Inglês para leitura de documentação técnica

Aqui você vai encontrar:

  • Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (Cartão Flash benefícios), Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, PPR, TotalPass, Auxílio Creche, Programa Well-Being (destinado para saúde física e mental), Universidade Corporativa (nossa #SensediaAcademy), com diversas trilhas de desenvolvimento; Parceiros culturais e educacionais, com descontos especiais; Somos uma empresa cidadã, proporcionando licença maternidade e licença paternidade estendida.

  • Temos #WorkWhereYouBelong como proposta de valor, que é um modelo flexível de trabalho que nos ajuda a aumentar o senso de pertencimento dos Sensediers.
    Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores, e o sentimento é de que exista apenas uma Sensedia em qualquer lugar que você esteja trabalhando.

Esta oportunidade também é para PCD! ;)

Suas experiências são compatíveis? Se candidate e venha conhecer a maior referência de APIs no Brasil! Queremos você em nossa equipe!!

  • Pensando em promover times cada vez mais diversos e ambientes de trabalho plurais, nossa missão é mapear os diferentes públicos que alcançamos com ele! Por isso, faremos algumas perguntinhas relacionadas à diversidade*, tudo bem? =)
*Os dados pessoais e dados pessoais sensíveis coletados serão tratados de acordo com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados - Lei n° 13.709/2018

raw.excerpt: Our StoryTopDog Law is not your typical law firm.
raw.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

TopDog Law is scaling quickly, and Intake sits at the center of that growth. We are looking for a Director of Intake Operations who can build the leadership, operating discipline, and execution needed to turn demand into qualified opportunities, signed clients, and an exceptional first experience with our firm.

This is a build-and-lead role, not a maintenance role. You will lead a multi-function organization spanning Intake, In-House Signing, White Glove, and Reception/Client Success and create the structure, accountability, and operating rhythm that allow each team to perform at a high level as we continue to grow.

You will be accountable for execution against the KPIs that matter most to Intake, including true-to-routed rate, sign rate, speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, intake quality, and agent productivity. The VP of Contact Strategy will set the direction, priorities, and target outcomes; your job is to turn that direction into clear operating plans, develop the leaders responsible for delivery, remove barriers, and make sure improvements stick. The Manager of Intake owns the day-to-day operation of Intake and

In-House Signing, while White Glove and Reception/Client Success leadership report directly to the Director until those functions require additional manager-level structure.

What You Will Own

Turn Strategy Into Execution

  • Take Contact Strategy priorities, KPI targets, and major firm initiatives and turn them into clear operating plans with owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build a consistent operating cadence across Intake, In-House Signing, White Glove, and Reception/Client Success so leaders know what matters, where performance stands, and what needs action.
  • Create alignment across specialized teams without forcing a one-size-fits-all approach to workflows, skills, or client handling.
  • Make change stick by ensuring new processes are communicated clearly, trained effectively, measured, and reinforced by leaders.

Know the Numbers and Drive Performance

  • Own execution against established Intake KPIs, including true-to-routed rate, sign rate, speed to lead, answer rate, contact rate, intake quality, and agent productivity.
  • Run disciplined business reviews that move beyond reporting the numbers to identifying root causes, assigning actions, and following through to results.
  • Translate department goals into clear expectations for managers, supervisors, teams, and individual contributors so every level understands how it contributes to the outcome.
  • Partner with Analytics to build trusted, actionable reporting and use the data to spot trends early, test solutions, and measure impact.

Build Leaders Who Build High-Performing Teams

  • Lead and develop the Manager of Intake and other functional leaders, giving them clear ownership, decision rights, expectations, and coaching.
  • Hold direct reports accountable for the day-to-day performance of Intake and In-House Signing, including supervisor effectiveness, productivity, coaching, quality, and process adherence.
  • Directly lead White Glove and Reception/Client Success leadership and determine when growth, complexity, or span of control warrants additional manager-level structure.
  • Build leadership bench strength and succession plans so the organization can continue to scale without creating single points of dependency.

Keep Intake Ready for What Comes Next

  • Make sure Intake is ready to execute new law firm initiatives, state launches, policy changes, case-evaluation updates, and new workflows from day one.
  • Partner with Learning & Development, Quality Assurance, and Legal to ensure training is accurate, practical, timely, and reinforced in the operation.
  • Use QA findings, conversion trends, decline patterns, and performance data to identify where the team needs stronger knowledge, coaching, or retraining.
  • Set a high bar for decision accuracy, routing quality, documentation, client communication, and process compliance across every Intake function.

Improve Conversion and Prospective Client Experience

  • Drive initiatives that make it easier and faster for prospective clients to reach us, complete Intake, understand next steps, and move toward the right outcome.
  • Find and eliminate friction, unnecessary handoffs, inconsistent processes, and missed opportunities throughout the prospective-client journey.
  • Raise the bar on follow-up execution, objection handling, intake decision quality, case routing, and signing readiness.
  • Standardize the fundamentals while preserving the specialized approach required for catastrophic, high-value, sensitive, or complex client interactions.

Stay Ahead of Demand

  • Partner with Workforce Management to connect lead volume and marketing investment to forecasting, staffing, schedules, hiring plans, and capacity decisions.
  • Keep staffing and leadership capacity ahead of anticipated demand so growth does not come at the expense of speed, conversion, quality, or client experience.
  • Use productivity, adherence, shrinkage, overtime, coverage, and capacity trends to identify where operating changes are needed before they become performance problems.
  • Make balanced operating decisions that consider service, conversion, employee experience, quality, and cost together.

Connect Intake to the Rest of the Business

  • Serve as the senior Intake partner to Contact Strategy Platforms, Workforce Management, Quality Assurance, Learning & Development, Analytics, Marketing, Legal, and other operational teams.
  • Turn business problems into clear requirements for Genesys, Salesforce, Filevine, reporting, automation, AI, and other tools that support Intake.
  • Own operational readiness for technology and workflow changes by making sure testing, training, communication, and adoption are complete before and after launch.
  • Drive cross-functional issues to resolution when they are affecting conversion, client experience, quality, productivity, or employee performance.

Protect the Business and Communicate Clearly

  • Ensure Intake consistently follows approved legal, compliance, calling, recording, documentation, data-handling, and client-communication requirements.
  • Surface material operational, client, compliance, staffing, or capacity risks early and bring forward clear recommendations, owners, and next steps.
  • Give the VP of Contact Strategy a concise, transparent view of performance, risks, priorities, execution progress, and resource needs.
  • Build a culture where leaders move with urgency, own their results, solve problems at the right level, and keep the client at the center of decisions.

What You Bring

Required:

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in legal intake, contact center operations, sales, customer acquisition, or another high-volume, performance- driven service environment, including 5+ years leading managers, supervisors, or multiple layers of frontline leadership.
  • Demonstrated success improving conversion, contact rate, speed to lead, service, quality, productivity, or comparable operating metrics.
  • Experience leading multiple operational functions, teams, shifts, or locations with different workflows, customer needs, and performance expectations.
  • Strong working knowledge of performance management, workforce planning, quality, training, and operational analytics, with the ability to diagnose root causes and turn data into action.
  • Strong executive communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence decisions, and move work forward in a fast-changing environment.
  • High ownership, strong judgment, and the ability to balance growth, client experience, employee development, compliance, operational discipline, and financial performance.

Preferred (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with Salesforce, Genesys Cloud CX, Filevine, or comparable CRM and contact center platforms.
  • Experience leading teams across multiple locations, countries, or time zones and driving large-scale operational change, automation, or AI-enabled workflows.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: [Min} and [Max], commensurate with experience
  • Eligible for performance-based bonus
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.

Who are we and what do we do?

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.

Role in Nutshell:

The sales operations function at BrowserStack owns the go-to-market strategy for the direct sales business and works with internal functions including Sales, Engineering, Product, Finance and HR to build and operationalise the GTM strategy. The scope of the function spans - GTM strategy to drive expansion and growth, Systems/Tools/ Processes design, sales enablement, sales compensation, sales funnel optimisation & BI and reporting.

What will you do?

  • Work with relevant stakeholders including Finance, Engineering, and Product teams to drive the project roadmap, and implement the solution

Desired Experience:

  • At least 4+ years of relevant experience at management consulting firms or investment banks; or similar BizOps experience in the technology domain

  • Structured thinking, strong problem-solving skills & a solid business sense

  • Proficient in analytics and be able to develop actionable insights using data

  • Be able to multitask, prioritise, rapidly iterate and manage communications with different functions in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Strong interpersonal, communication and presentation skills.

WHO WE ARE

EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will play a foundational role in building our sales development function from the ground up. You'll manage both inbound lead qualifications and strategic outbound prospecting through email, LinkedIn, and phone outreach. Rather than focusing on high-volume cold outreach, this role emphasizes thoughtful, relationship-driven engagement with a highly targeted audience of healthcare finance executives.

This is a newly established function within the company, so we need someone who can hit the ground running from day one — bringing prior SDR experience and a strong work ethic to consistently execute outbound and inbound motions. As our process matures, your day-to-day results and hands-on experience will naturally inform how we refine outreach and workflows, but the priority is execution first. This role offers a clear path for growth into future sales or marketing positions as our team scales.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

    Outbound Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Execute targeted outbound prospecting campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and phone.
  • Build relationships with prospective healthcare organizations through personalized, consultative outreach.
  • Identify and engage qualified decision-makers within target accounts.

    • Inbound Lead Qualification

  • Respond to and qualify inbound leads.
  • Assess prospect fit and schedule discovery meetings for the appropriate Account Executive.
  • Maintain timely follow-up and nurture opportunities through the early stages of the sales cycle.

    • Meeting & Relationship Management

  • Schedule discovery/introductory calls, meetings, demos, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with prospective and existing customers.
  • Develop trusted relationships with healthcare finance leaders through consistent communication and follow-up.

    • CRM & Sales Operations

  • Maintain accurate activity, notes, and opportunity tracking within Salesforce.
  • Utilize sales engagement platforms such as SalesLoft (or similar) to execute outreach campaigns.
  • Monitor outreach performance and provide feedback on campaign effectiveness.

    • Process Improvement

  • Contribute ideas to improve outbound strategies, messaging, workflows, and SDR best practices.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Client Success teams to continuously optimize the sales development process.

REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2–3+ years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, or outbound prospecting.
  • Experience selling into healthcare, healthcare technology, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), financial services, or another complex B2B industry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience engaging executive-level buyers through outbound prospecting.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong relationship-building and consultative selling abilities.
  • Experience with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms.
  • Familiarity with sales engagement tools such as SalesLoft, Outreach, Apollo, or similar platforms.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Self-starter who thrives in an evolving environment.
  • Comfortable helping build and improve sales processes.
  • Professional, polished communicator capable of engaging senior executives.
  • Curious, proactive, and eager to contribute beyond daily outreach activities.
  • Collaborative team player with a continuous improvement mindset.

SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS & PREREQUISITES

  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp's Core Values, Vision and Mission.
  • Strong familiarity with the healthcare revenue cycle, reimbursement processes, and the challenges faced by healthcare providers in optimizing financial performance.
  • Hands-on individual contributor, able to build strong relationships at multiple levels internally and with potential and existing clients.
  • Demonstrated experience in partnering and influencing in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to manage priorities and set and achieve goals/objectives.
  • Some travel required (less than 30%), primarily for occasional team, client meetings, trade shows/conferences, or company offsites.
  • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment.

EnableComp recruits, develops and retains the industry's top talent. As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.

NBCUniversal Advertising Products & Solutions (AP&S) is responsible for the product development and project management of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. From sales support to campaign execution, delivery, and billing, our division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $7B+ annual advertising business. Together, we’re building the platform that powers the future of advertising at NBCU.

Our Data Collaboration Group, a core part of AP&S, powers the full advertiser lifecycle across insights, measurement, onboarding, activation, and optimization, utilizing various integration pathways including Data Clean Rooms and secure data shares.

Within the Data Collaboration Group, our Engineering & Operations team builds the automation and platform capabilities behind these workflows. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Automation Engineering to join the Engineering & Operations team. Reporting to the Director of Automation Engineering, this role will build AI-enabled automation systems and production-grade software that support NBCUniversal’s data collaboration ecosystem. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Python engineer who can design reliable systems, productize repeatable workflows, and build AI agents that help automate complex engineering and operational tasks across data platforms for audience activation, measurement, and reporting. 

Responsibilities:

  • AI Agent & Automation Engineering 

    • Design and build internal AI agents and automation workflows using technologies such as, Snowflake Cortex, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks, to support planning, tool use, retrieval, validation, and human-in-the-loop execution where appropriate. 

    • Develop reusable tools, APIs, and components that engineers can compose into new agentic workflows. 

    • Implement retrieval-augmented generation workflows, context management strategies, and prompt patterns that improve accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. 

  • Agent Evaluation & Reliability 

    • Build evaluation harnesses, regression tests, and monitoring patterns for AI-agent behavior. 

    • Define and track metrics such as task completion, groundedness, response accuracy, latency, cost, and failure rate. 

    • Design guardrails and validation patterns to reduce hallucinations, unsafe outputs, and unreliable automation behavior. 

    • Partner with engineering and operations teams to move AI workflows from prototype to production-ready systems. 

  • Software Engineering & Platform Development 

    • Design, build, and maintain production-grade Python applications, libraries, and services. 

    • Champion object-oriented design principles, including encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance/composition, reusable interfaces, and clean separation of concerns to improve maintainability and extensibility. 

    • Champion software engineering best practices including modular design, automated testing, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, and documentation. 

    • Create reusable engineering patterns that reduce bespoke development effort and improve consistency across partner engagements. 

    • Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and data platform teams to translate repeatable business needs into scalable technical solutions. 

  • Audience & Measurement Productization 

    • Build reusable Python libraries that support clean room capabilities across first-party audience workflows and core measurement use cases, including audience onboarding, ingestion, indexing, activation, campaign and impression delivery analysis, reach and frequency, attribution, and incrementality. 

    • Abstract complex analytical and data collaboration workflows into repeatable, self-service components for internal teams and external partners. 

    • Enable configurable feature deployment so new audience and measurement capabilities can be delivered quickly and consistently across partners. 

  • Technical Mentorship 

    • Mentor engineers through code reviews, technical design discussions, and operational best practices. 

    • Help establish engineering standards for AI-assisted workflows, agentic system design, reusable libraries, and production automation. 

    • Promote a culture of reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. 

Required Qualifications

  • Education

    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field 

  • Software Engineering

    • 5+ years of experience building production-grade software using Python, including libraries, services, testing, CI/CD, and code reviews 

  • AI / LLM Engineering

    • Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs, RAG, vector databases, prompt engineering, or frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or similar tools 

  • Agentic Systems / Automation 

    • Experience designing AI-enabled workflows, reasoning agents, tool-using agents, or complex automation systems 

  • Data Platforms 

    • 3+ years of hands-on experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or similar technologies 

  • Systems Design 

    • Strong understanding of production system design, including observability, reliability, scalability, performance tuning, and operational support 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Clean Room Knowledge 

    • Exposure to data clean room concepts or platforms such as Snowflake Clean Rooms, Databricks Clean Rooms, LiveRamp, Habu, or similar technologies 

  • Ad Tech / Measurement 

    • Experience with advertising technology, audience activation, campaign delivery, reach and frequency, attribution, incrementality, or reporting workflows 

  • Certifications 

    • Snowflake SnowPro Core Certification, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or similar cloud/data platform certification 

Additional Requirements:

  • Full Remote: This position has been designated as fully remote, meaning that the position is expected to contribute from a non-NBCUniversal worksite, most commonly an employee’s residence.

  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

  • Salary Range: $140,000 - $180,000 (bonus eligible)

• Understands the demands of real-time rendering and performance optimization.
• Have extensive experience with multi-threaded rendering and can optimize complex systems to maximize performance.
• Are proficient in low-level graphics APIs such as OpenGL, Metal, and DirectX, and can leverage these tools to create efficient and high-performing rendering solutions.
• Write in C++ as their primary language, demonstrating deep expertise and comfort with its nuances.

We really want people who:
• Have extensive experience working with the FFmpeg library and can integrate video and audio processing capabilities into sophisticated applications.

• Have an understanding of embedded programming and can work with hardware to optimize performance for specific platforms.
Our best engineers will have:
• Experience working with broadcast audio and video standards and technologies, such as AAC, ProRes, H.265, MPEG-DASH, HLS, SRT and various compression formats, ensuring compatibility and quality in diverse environments.
• Familiarity with rendering on multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, and Linux, with an understanding of platform-specific challenges and optimizations.
• A problem-solving mindset, with the ability to diagnose and address bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and rendering challenges.
• A passion for creating efficient, reliable, and scalable rendering systems, improving every aspect of the media delivery process.

raw.title: Senior Enterprise Risk Manager
raw.excerpt: About UsAre you looking to make a meaningful impact through your work?
raw.description:
About Us

Are you looking to make a meaningful impact through your work? Join us at the Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE). We are an SEC-registered national securities exchange designed to promote fair and orderly markets, as well as help long-term focused companies get the credit they deserve. We are an innovative business ecosystem dedicated to reimagining the role of capital markets for a more equitable and sustainable future.

At LTSE, we work with companies to identify long-term investors that will value their efforts to prioritize sustainable, long-term growth. As part of our team, you will have the opportunity to leverage your diverse background and skills toward a compelling mission that delivers tangible results. By supporting businesses in creating multi-stakeholder value, we generate a positive ripple effect that benefits communities, employees, and beyond.

Founded by Eric Ries, a visionary entrepreneur and creator of the Lean Startup methodology, LTSE offers a unique and rewarding environment where you can contribute to building a better future for all. Apply today.

The Opportunity

LTSE is looking for an Enterprise Risk Manager who brings both rigor and practical judgment to complex business and regulatory questions. In this role, you will help shape and operate an enterprise risk management program that supports sound decisions, responsible growth, and the resilience of the exchange.

This is an opportunity for an experienced risk professional who wants meaningful ownership - not simply maintaining a framework, but working directly with leaders and teams across the company to surface risk early, challenge assumptions thoughtfully, and turn analysis into action. You will lead significant ERM work, advise cross-functional partners, and help make risk management a useful part of how LTSE operates.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead significant components of LTSE's enterprise risk management program, including risk identification, assessment, monitoring, governance, documentation, and reporting.
  • Plan and facilitate enterprise and functional risk assessments, bringing together quantitative and qualitative information to identify priorities and recommend action.
  • Own the quality and ongoing maintenance of the enterprise risk register, including risk ratings, controls, mitigation plans, accountable owners, and progress updates.
  • Monitor key risk indicators, incidents, control issues, audit findings, regulatory developments, market trends, and emerging risks—and ensure material concerns are surfaced promptly.
  • Partner with colleagues across trading, compliance, legal, finance, technology, operations, marketing, and other functions to embed effective risk practices into decisions and day-to-day work.
  • Develop and improve risk policies, procedures, frameworks, standards, and tools so they remain practical, current, and responsive to LTSE's evolving needs.
  • Design and lead scenario analyses, stress tests, control evaluations, and other complex risk reviews, selecting the right approach for each question.
  • Prepare clear risk reporting and recommendations for senior leaders and governance forums, and support materials for the Audit Committee, regulators, and external auditors.
  • Lead assigned workstreams for regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, and other assurance activities—from coordinating responses through driving follow-up actions.
  • Serve as a trusted risk advisor on cross-functional projects, business changes, and new initiatives, helping teams balance opportunity, regulatory expectations, and LTSE's risk appetite.
  • Own LTSE’s third-party vendor management review process, and seek out smarter ways to work by improving or automating risk processes, data collection, reporting, and controls.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Deep working knowledge of enterprise risk management frameworks, methods, and tools, with the judgment to adapt them to complex business and regulatory questions.
  • Experience independently planning and leading complex risk work, establishing an effective approach, coordinating contributors, and knowing when an issue needs to be escalated.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, paired with the ability to synthesize complexity into clear, practical recommendations.
  • The confidence and credibility to ask thoughtful questions, constructively challenge assumptions, and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to make risk information useful to technical, business, executive, and governance audiences.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience in enterprise, operational, compliance, technology, financial, or a related area of risk management—ideally within financial services, a regulated organization, an exchange, broker-dealer, fintech, or market infrastructure environment.
  • Deep understanding of market structure, trading mechanisms, regulatory requirements, internal controls, audit, or governance processes.
  • At least 6-8 years of directly related or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with risk reporting, data visualization, or workflow automation tools.
  • A relevant professional certification, such as FRM, CRMP, RIMS-CRMP, CISA, or a comparable credential.

How We Work

At LTSE, long-term thinking and urgency go hand in hand. We value people who take responsibility, work transparently, seek out different perspectives, and approach difficult problems with curiosity and precision. In this role, you will have room to lead while working closely with colleagues who care about building durable systems, learning quickly, and improving how work gets done.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprise risk sits at the intersection of nearly every important decision an exchange makes. The person in this role will have visibility across the organization and the opportunity to influence how LTSE anticipates challenges, makes tradeoffs, and builds for resilience. Your work will help protect the business while enabling teams to move forward with greater clarity and confidence.

LTSE's Compensation Philosophy

The target salary range for this role is $155,000 - $195,000 with an anticipated starting salary at the midpoint of $175,000.

Base compensation is part of a total rewards package including stock options and benefits, and may include additional performance incentives. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually using multiple databases including Pave, Radford, McLagan, and other peer sets, to ensure competitive and fair pay.

To determine the compensation for the role, we use a data-driven, blended rate approach to ensure we are paying competitively among our peers by benchmarking to companies of similar size and stage, and hire at the 50th percentile of the salary range.

Benefits

Some benefits may only be available for full-time employees. Please check with your recruiter to find out which benefits you are eligible for.

  • Drive Innovation. Make an impact working with a mission-driven company that shares your desire to create a new kind of public market.
  • Meet Great People. Work with skilled, committed, and supportive teammates, that have a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  • Achieve Balance. Enjoy the LTSE commitment to a sustainable remote-first work environment, including a flexible vacation policy.
  • Prioritize Health. Take charge of your health with rich medical, dental, vision, and EAP benefits. 100% of employee costs are sponsored by LTSE and there is a small, fixed employee contribution for dependent costs.
  • Focus on Family. All new parents receive up to 4 months of caregiver leave including 8 weeks of full salary continuation, all while keeping your full company-sponsored benefits for up to the full 4 months.
  • Foster Holistic Wellness and Growth. Receive reimbursements for up to $2000 worth of physical fitness, mental health and wellness, family care, pet care, and learning and development purchases and/or charitable giving annually with our Lifestyle Spending Accounts.
  • Get Set Up for Success. Launch quickly with your company provided laptop, cell phone reimbursement, and $500 home-office stipend.
  • Invest in Savings. Enroll in our 401k program offered through Human Interest, and other benefit programs offered through Gusto.
  • Take Ownership. Full-time employees receive LTSE equity options in both of our entities, with a generous exercise period for those who reach a 2-year milestone.

LTSE offers remote employment to candidates who reside in select states.

LTSE is committed to championing a performance based culture to advance the LTSE mission. This requires the highest level of employee engagement with a broad diversity of perspective, background and capability to accelerate mission actualization and impact. We believe that inclusion is a team effort, and every team member is expected to participate in building a welcoming and representative culture.

LTSE is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran, genetic information, marital status or any other legally protected status.We enthusiastically work to make our application and interview processes accessible for candidates with disabilities.

raw.description:
We're looking for a full-stack engineer to join our Product Engineering team, reporting to one of the Engineering Managers of the Marketplace area, with a dotted line to the Marketing SEO Manager, focused on supporting the Growth and Marketing area. This role will have a 60% focus on Front End, and 40% focus on Back End.

You'll work on Treatwell’s Marketplace products and help Treatwell be discovered, understood, and chosen across 13 markets: SEO foundations, site performance, experimentation, analytics instrumentation, and the product surfaces that connect customer intent with booking, alongside three product engineering teams in the Marketplace area, contributing across the full breadth of what makes Treatwell's marketplace tick. As a full-stack engineer, you're the person who can move fluidly between teams accelerating growth and marketing efforts wherever the need is greatest.

You bring the mindset of someone who cares about how people find Treatwell, what experience they land on, and whether the product helps them make a confident booking. You are comfortable partnering with marketing and growth stakeholders, while staying grounded in engineering quality and product outcomes.

➡️ Our product is built on:

  • Backend: Java, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, MS-SQL
  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Cypress, Jest
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, AWS, Datadog
  • Mindset: DevOps, DDD, event-driven architecture

💡 About Treatwell

Hi, we’re Treatwell. Nice to meet you.

We’re a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We’re the industry’s smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe’s leading bookings platform, working with over 50,000 salon partners across 13 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And….breathe.

But we’re not done yet. We’re on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community.

If this excites you, we might just have the role for you.

🧐 You will be responsible for:

  • Growth and marketing engineering - build and evolve the technical foundations that support customer acquisition, activation, and retention across Treatwell's markets
  • Discoverability - improve how search engines and users understand Treatwell's marketplace, without turning the role into a pure SEO implementation function
  • Experimentation and measurement - instrument your work, support testing frameworks, and help teams validate ideas with data before scaling them
  • Product surfaces - ship user-facing improvements to landing pages, discovery journeys, and conversion flows, owning the work from problem framing through production
  • Platform quality - own your services end-to-end, from architecture through deployment, with a DevOps mindset baked in
  • Cross-functional clarity - translate growth and marketing opportunities into clear engineering work, challenge scope when needed, and keep quality standards high

🔝 About you:

  • You have proven experience owning production-grade web applications end-to-end, and understand that the best technical decisions come from deeply understanding the problem - not just the code (mid/senior level)
  • You own features end-to-end - from database schema to UI, without needing a handoff
  • You think in systems and trade-offs, not just tickets - you spot the upstream cause, not just the downstream symptom
  • You have a product mindset - you think about the person using what you build, ask why before how, and push back when something doesn't make sense
  • You're data-driven and hypothesis-led - you instrument your work, measure impact, and use evidence to make decisions
  • You can partner with non-engineering stakeholders, turning ambiguous growth or marketing needs into sensible technical options
  • You will act as the key technical partner for marketing stakeholders, evaluating the feasibility of their requests, managing expectations, and finding the right trade-off between business speed and technical quality (TBC).
  • You are able to make progress in evolving or complex domains while collaborating to create clarity - growth work often moves fast, and you know how to navigate that without getting paralysed
  • Experience with SEO, experimentation, analytics, performance, or growth-related product areas
  • Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or similar - and clear opinions about where they genuinely add value is a plus
  • You can communicate fluently in English.
  • You are based in any city within Italy or Spain, with a valid right to work - candidates outside of these countries will not be considered.

NOTE: If you don't meet every requirement but believe you'd thrive in this role, we'd still love to hear from you.

💼 We’ll treat you with:

  • 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays 🏖️
  • Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too 💅🏻
  • Mental health support through our partnership with Open-Up 🧘🏻
  • 100% remote position 🧑🏻‍💻
  • Market-specific benefits that will be discussed in the interview process

⚖️ Equal Opportunities

Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process as required. Please add any adjustment requests to your application.
