raw.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

About College Pads

College Pads is transforming the way students navigate the transition from on-campus to off-campus life. Our platform enables universities to support their students by streamlining the process of finding and securing off-campus housing. By working closely with higher education institutions, we offer a trusted tool for students to connect with property managers and rental listings, helping to foster a foundation for wellbeing and success. As of January 2025, College Pads is part of StarRez.

The Role

StarRez is seeking a highly driven and strategic Enterprise Account Executive to join our College Pads sales team. In this role, you will lead complex, high-value sales engagements with enterprise-level property management groups, ownership groups, and real estate organizations. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategic territory plans, building executive-level relationships, and driving significant revenue growth through new business acquisition and expansion opportunities.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles, deliver consultative solutions tailored to client needs, and position College Pads as a strategic partner within the student housing ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Client Success, and Customer Service teams to support long-term client retention, expansion, and market growth.

Role Specifics

  • Work Location: Remote (US)
  • Travel: 25% (The percentage of travel is an estimation and could vary based on business needs.)
  • Compensation Structure: In addition to the base salary listed below, this role is eligible for a bonus/commission plan.When meeting 100% of goals, the expected total annual compensation for this role is $230,000.
  • Reporting Structure: This role reports to the VP, Sales.

Application Deadline: This role will accept applications until filled.

What You Will Own

  • Identifying, prospecting, and securing new enterprise partnerships with large-scale property management companies, ownership groups, and real estate organizations within your assigned territory
  • Managing complex sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, including multi-stakeholder engagement and executive-level presentations
  • Developing strategic account plans to drive long-term revenue growth, client retention, and expansion opportunities across enterprise accounts
  • Delivering consultative sales presentations that effectively communicate the value of the College Pads platform and align solutions to client business objectives
  • Building and maintaining strong, long-lasting relationships with senior decision-makers and key stakeholders across enterprise accounts
  • Partnering closely with Marketing, Client Success, and Customer Service teams to develop strategies that drive customer acquisition, adoption, and retention
  • Providing market intelligence and feedback on industry trends, competitor activity, and evolving client needs to help shape product strategy and go-to-market initiatives
  • Meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets through consistent pipeline generation, strategic deal management, and successful execution

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience with either:
    • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 1 year of enterprise sales experience; or
    • 5+ years of experience in the off-campus student housing industry, including experience with an owner, operator, or third-party property management organization, with demonstrated experience in sales, leasing, marketing, operations, property management, or commercial leadership
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, consultative B2B sales cycles or influence complex business decisions involving multiple stakeholders
  • Strong executive presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to build credibility with and influence senior decision-makers
  • Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, with experience navigating complex contracts, pricing discussions, partnerships, or other high-stakes business decisions
  • Demonstrated track record of achieving ambitious sales, commercial, operational, or portfolio performance goals in a high-performance environment
  • Strong organizational and account, territory, or portfolio management skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively and operate independently in a remote environment
  • Proficiency with CRM or comparable business systems, with strong discipline around activity tracking, account documentation, pipeline or portfolio management, forecasting, and reporting

Preferred Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field
  • Previous experience selling into the real estate, property management, student housing, or multifamily housing industries
  • Experience managing enterprise or strategic accounts within a fast-paced, growth-oriented company
  • Familiarity with the needs and challenges of college housing is a significant advantage
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership teams and navigating enterprise procurement processes

Reasons to join our Team:

  • Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
  • Full benefits including health care, paid time off, life insurance, and 401k plan with company match for eligible team members.
  • A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
  • Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
  • Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.

Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:

StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.

Compensation Structure: In addition to the base salary listed below, this role is eligible for a bonus/commission plan. When meeting 100% of goals, the expected total annual compensation for this role is $230,000.

US - Salary Range
$115,000—$115,000 USD

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses. We help companies build high-performing teams across executive assistance, administrative support, customer support, sales support, recruiting, operations, and other critical business functions.

The Role

We're looking for a Head of Sales Performance to build, own, and multiply the performance of our inbound sales engine from the first follow-up touch through close.

This is a builder's role, not a caretaker's. You won't be inheriting a finished machine; you'll be constructing one. That means creating the tools, sequences, collateral, coaching systems, and standards that make every rep on the floor measurably better and personally stepping into the work when needed.

You will lead the inbound follow-up function, strengthen the systems and processes behind it, coach the team, and ensure every qualified opportunity is managed with discipline and urgency. Beyond your direct team, you will raise the quality and consistency of how the entire sales floor sells through coaching, performance management, process improvement, and the thoughtful use of sales technology.

You will have a team, a modern sales tech stack, and clear revenue and performance targets tied directly to your ownership. As you establish the sales performance engine, your scope may expand into post-sale revenue onboarding, retention, and account expansion.

What You'll Own

    Build the Sales Performance Toolkit

    • Create the sales assets the floor runs on: sequences, talk tracks, objection-handling guides, battle cards, and demo collateral from zero where nothing exists today
    • Identify gaps in the sales motion and build the tool, process, or content that closes them
    • Evaluate, implement, and get real leverage from AI-enabled sales tools, conversation intelligence, and automation

      • Team Leadership

      • Manage and develop the inbound follow-up team, including SDRs and Sales Associates
      • Conduct regular 1:1s, coach performance, and hire as the team scales
      • Own the pairing model between Sales Associates and Account Executives
      • Establish cadence standards, ownership rules, and CRM hygiene expectations
      • Manage the Sales Trainer and own onboarding and ramp-up for all new sales hires

        • Follow-Up and Mid-Funnel Conversion

        • Design, write, and A/B test follow-up sequences across email and chat
        • Use reply rate, re-engagement rate, and conversion as your primary scorecards
        • Build and manage the no-show recovery motion for cancellations and missed demos
        • Turn missed and cancelled demos into rebooked conversations
        • Build and run reactivation campaigns for aged and closed-lost opportunities
        • Reduce stage-to-stage drop-off across the funnel, beginning with the weakest-performing stage

          • Channel Partner Lead Management

          • Oversee the handling of leads and opportunities generated through channel partnerships
          • Establish clear ownership, follow-up, and reporting standards for partner-sourced opportunities
          • Track channel partner performance and evaluate its effectiveness as a source of new business

            • Sales Quality and Coaching

            • Review recorded calls and demos using a written sales scorecard
            • Maintain a fixed monthly call-review coverage target for every representative
            • Coach Account Executives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and securing second calls
            • Run regular calibration sessions to ensure consistent scoring and coaching standards
            • Join live deals when a representative needs support moving an opportunity forward

              • Knowledge and Compliance

              • Own the sales knowledge base as the company's single source of truth
              • Maintain the content that powers our AI sales chat assistant
              • Establish a regular review cadence so customer-facing information remains accurate and current
              • Ensure claims made by sales representatives and automated channels are accurate and compliant

Requirements

    • At least 4 years of experience in inside sales, sales development, sales enablement, revenue operations, or a similar commercial role
    • At least 2 years of experience managing or coaching a sales team
    • A track record of building sales systems, tools, or programs from scratch not just running ones that already existed
    • Proven experience improving follow-up, pipeline conversion, show rates, or sales-cycle performance
    • Strong understanding of inbound sales funnels, lead management, and mid-funnel conversion
    • Experience coaching sales representatives on discovery, objection handling, urgency, and deal progression
    • Ability to review sales calls, identify performance gaps, and provide clear, actionable feedback
    • Hands-on experience building sales sequences across email, chat, SMS, or other follow-up channels
    • Strong CRM discipline and experience working with platforms such as HubSpot or Salesforce
    • Comfortable using data to diagnose funnel problems, set targets, and manage performance
    • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
    • Willingness and ability to work Pacific Time hours

      • Preferred

      • Experience managing both SDRs or Sales Associates and Account Executives
      • Experience owning sales onboarding, training, and rep ramp-up programs
      • Experience building no-show recovery, closed-lost reactivation, or aged-pipeline campaigns
      • Familiarity with AI-enabled sales tools, conversation intelligence, and sales automation platforms
      • Experience creating sales collateral, playbooks, or enablement content adopted floor-wide
      • Experience working in a high-growth startup, SaaS, staffing, outsourcing, or technology-enabled services company
      • Experience managing leads generated through channel partnerships
      • Familiarity with compliance, sales claims management, and maintaining a customer-facing knowledge base

What Success Looks Like

You are a strong fit for this role if you are a hands-on operator and a force multiplier someone who makes the people and systems around them better, not just their own numbers.

You should be comfortable moving between strategy and execution: reviewing a dashboard in the morning, rewriting a follow-up sequence at noon, coaching an underperforming representative in the afternoon, and helping an Account Executive move a difficult deal forward before the day ends. When something the team needs doesn't exist, your instinct is to build it.

About Goods & Services

Goods & Services is a product design and engineering company.

We solve mission-critical challenges for some of the world’s largest enterprises, with deep expertise in highly regulated industries—including life sciences and financial services. Our design-led approach allows us to apply cutting-edge capabilities in AI,Data and Hardware Engineering to companies of any size.

Headquartered in the United States, we operate regional development centers in Mexico and the United Kingdom. This global footprint—anchored by our nearshore model—enables us to deliver at scale with the speed, efficiency, and cultural alignment our clients expect.

At Goods and Services, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds.

About the job

Goods & Services is looking for a Senior Release Manager who serves as the operational bridge between Release Train Engineers (RTEs), Enterprise Program Managers (EPMs), and also works with Systems Engineering, DevOps, Quality, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to ensure mobile software releases are planned, documented, approved, deployed, and monitored successfully.

What you’ll do:

  • Release Planning & Coordination / Documentation Readiness:
    • Coordinate creation, review, approval, and release of software lifecycle documentation.
    • Create or Track readiness of all documents
    • Maintain documentation dependency maps and critical path analysis.
    • Escalate documentation gaps that could delay testing, regulatory submissions, or deployment readiness
  • Deployment Management
    • Own deployment planning for Internal releases, Limited Market Releases (LMR), Feature Rollouts, International Deployments, Sustaining Patches, and Hotfixes
    • Coordinate deployment execution with DevOps and IT teams.
    • Manage staged rollout strategies, rollback plans, deployment targeting, pilot groups, and production monitoring.
    • Track deployment performance metrics and launch outcomes.
    • Coordinate hypercare activities following releases
  • Release Readiness Governance
    • Lead release readiness reviews and deployment readiness assessments.
    • Establish readiness criteria for each deployment phase.
    • Facilitate cross-functional go/no-go reviews
  • Process Improvement
    • Standardize release management practices across mobile teams.
    • Develop reusable templates for deployment plans, readiness reviews, risk tracking, and release reporting.
    • Identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
    • Support scaling of release processes across multiple concurrent product releases

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years in software release management, program management, systems engineering, PMO, or technical operations.
  • Experience supporting mobile applications and cloud-connected systems.
  • Experience in regulated industries (medical device, healthcare, pharmaceutical, aerospace, or similar).
  • Experience with Agile/SAFe environments.

Nice to have:

  • PMP certification.
  • SAFe certification.
  • Experience with Android and iOS release processes.
  • Experience with app store deployments and OTA update strategies.
  • Knowledge of Design Controls, Quality Systems, and Software Development Lifecycle documentation.

  • Lead VMware upgrades, lifecycle management cycles, and security patching across the virtualization estate, planning carefully sequenced rollouts that minimize disruption to dependent workloads.
  • Troubleshoot complex VMware issues spanning compute, network, and storage layers.
  • Stay current with VMware product evolution following the Broadcom transition.

  • Deep expertise in vSphere, vCenter, and ESXi.
  • Hands-on experience with vSAN and storage policy management.

About the Role

High 5 Games is seeking a highly driven, data-obsessedB2C Operations CRM & Product Managerto lead and scale our player engagement, retention, and growth strategies.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between high-level growth strategy, campaign execution, and operations. You will own the end-to-end player communication lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion to VIP loyalty and reactivation. You will utilize inhouse marketing automation tools, A/B testing, and deep data analytics. If you thrive in an ad-hoc fast-paced environment and love building scalable CRM strategies that drive real business growth, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

CRM & Lifecycle Operations

  • Strategy & Execution:Design and coordinate the development and deployment of multi-channel CRM campaigns (In-App Messaging, Push Notifications, Email, SMS) aimed at driving player acquisition, retention, monetization, and reactivation.
  • Customer Journey Mapping:Design and optimize automated player journeys (onboarding, conversion flows, VIP loyalty tracks, and win-back sequences) through data-backed experimentation.
  • Database Hygiene & Segmentation:Lead the entire database workflow—from identifying target player segments and cleaning data to maintaining contact database accuracy and proper segmentation.

Growth & Lifecycle Optimization

  • Growth Initiatives:Partner with Marketing, Product, and Data Science teams to design growth tactics, rewards, incentives, and promotional mechanics tailored for social casino players.
  • A/B Testing & Experimentation:Rigorously test campaign creative, copy, timing, coin/bonus offers, and segmentation to maximize Open Rates, CTRs, and In-App Purchases (IAP).
  • Copywriting & Creative Messaging:Draft compelling, compliant, and high-converting campaign copy that simplifies complex game mechanics/promotions and engages casino players.

Performance, Analytics & Reporting

  • Data-Driven Insights:Analyze player behavioral data, cohort trends, and campaign metrics to uncover actionable insights that improve lifetime value and reduce churn.
  • KPI Tracking:Define, monitor, and present key performance indicators (Open Rates, Conversion Rates, ARPU, Retention Rates, ROI) in weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports for leadership.
  • Operational Alignment:Coordinate cross functionally across data team, design, customer support and product teams to ensure seamless execution of live operational events and promotions.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience:3+ years of experience in digital marketing, with a heavy emphasis on CRM, growth hacking, or lifecycle marketing (preferably inSocial Casino, iGaming or Cryptoecosystems).
  • CRM Tools:Hands-on experience with mobile marketing platforms and CRM/automation tools (e.g., Salesforce or similar).
  • Analytical Skills:Strong proficiency in marketing analytics, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker), and data analysis (Excel/SQL is a plus) to measure campaign ROI and player behavior.

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of B2C operations, CRM principles, retention loops, and player monetization strategies.
  • Excellent copywriting and communication skills with the ability to turn data into compelling player messaging.
  • Detail-oriented project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex campaigns simultaneously.
  • Location: Remote / Work from Home

The position will be located in Italy or Spain (remote setup), with a focus on Italy/Spain, but will also serve any other markets as per current needs.

  • Perform on-premise or cloud-based digital product installations as well as server, network and services configurations
  • Performs physical system installations, when needed (exceptional)

  • Provides technical support to customers and other Intuitive employees.

  • Supports tradeshow activity

Minimum:

  • 4-7 years of field service experience with medical systems preferred.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills – English and language spoken in at least the countries Italy or Spain, ideally both
  • Windows Operating System and server system administrator.

  • Proven administrative and record keeping skills.
  • Strong analysis, troubleshooting and debugging skills for a wide range of issues with the area of specialization
  • Ability to work independently and purposefully from remote.
  • Effective self-management with moderate supervision.

Preferred:

  • Hardware and Software installation and configuration.
  • Healthcare and Medical system installation.
  • LDAP configuration and troubleshooting.
  • SQL system administrator and troubleshooting.
  • Good knowledge of core IT technologies (e.g., network systems, operating systems, databases, access controls, IT operations, etc.).

Additional notes and physical requirements:

  • Ability to work from remote.
  • Able to enter surgical and other patient care areas.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%. Some short notice travel may be required.

The Manager, Accounting Services Operations is responsible for the overall performance, profitability, and scalability of Dine Technology's Back Office accounting services. This role provides operational leadership for the US and offshore accounting teams supporting Back Office accounting services, ensuring client deliverables are completed accurately, consistently, and on time while maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency.

The Manager is responsible for developing the operational framework that supports the service line, including creating and refining processes, standard operating procedures, workflows, and quality standards. As Dine Technology expands its service offerings, this role will design and implement the operational structure required to support new services and revenue streams.

Working closely with the U.S. team, the Manager monitors key performance indicators, capacity, and resource utilization to improve productivity, profitability, and team performance. While the U.S. team owns the client relationship and the offshore team executes the day-to-day accounting work, this role ensures the service delivery model is standardized, scalable, and positioned for continued growth.

This role is remote in the US. We are unable to offer work sponsorship for this role.

Who we are:

Dine Technology is an outsourced accounting and technology consulting firm serving mid-sized restaurant operators using Restaurant365. Established in 2016, we bring structure, clarity, and control to restaurant accounting through rigorous processes and deep system expertise. In addition to our core accounting and technology services, we provide cash management and balance sheet review services for RASI software and are actively expanding our capabilities to build broader accounting service offerings for Back Office Accounting Software.

Buyers Edge Platform stands at the forefront of revolutionizing the foodservice industry through technology, purchasing power and partnerships. We are dedicated to empowering stakeholders across the entire foodservice ecosystem (operators, distributors, manufacturers) with efficiency and unprecedented visibility. With a diverse portfolio of over a dozen brands, our mission is clear: to reduce costs, streamline the foodservice supply chain, and propel the industry from manual to automated.

Today, we are one of the largest players in foodservice, with over 200K operator locations across North America and over $50 billion of aggregated spend volume. Our commitment to foodservice excellence is proven in four distinct areas of value: Digital Procurement Network, Fresh Solutions, Supply Chain Management, and Software. Buyers Edge Platform is not just a provider – we are a strategic partner on the journey towards a more efficient, connected, and automated future for the foodservice industry.

  • Lead the daily operations of the Back Office Accounting Services function.
  • Establish priorities and ensure consistent execution across all client portfolios.
  • Own the operational performance, efficiency, and profitability of the service line.
  • Manage workload, staffing, capacity, and resource allocation to maximize productivity and client service.
  • Monitor operational, quality, and financial performance metrics and implement improvements where needed.
  • Develop, document, and continuously improve processes, SOPs, workflows, quality standards, and training materials.
  • Evaluate existing systems and workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement scalable operational solutions.
  • Design and implement the operational framework required to support new services, revenue streams, and business initiatives.
  • Lead operational improvement initiatives focused on automation, standardization, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management for the offshore accounting team.
  • Partner with the U.S. team and offshore leadership to ensure effective communication, coordination, and accountability.
  • Support the resolution of escalated operational and client service issues.
  • Foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting processes, with the ability to effectively support and oversee accounting operations.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Experience leading accounting operations or service delivery teams.
  • Strong operational and systems thinking with the ability to analyze complex processes, identify root causes, and develop scalable solutions.
  • Ability to assess existing workflows and operating models, determine what is effective and what is not, and implement practical process improvements.
  • Proven ability to design, document, and implement new processes, standard operating procedures, and operational frameworks.
  • Ability to translate complex operational challenges into clear, executable action plans and successfully lead organizational change.
  • Ability to develop scalable processes, SOPs, and operational controls.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on efficiency and profitability.
  • Experience using KPIs and operational metrics to drive performance.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across U.S. and offshore teams.

About you:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
  • 7+ years of progressive experience in accounting, accounting operations, shared services, or outsourced accounting.
  • 3+ years of leadership experience managing accounting operations, service delivery, or multi-team environments.
  • Foundational knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting, and month-end close processes.
  • Restaurant, hospitality, or multi-unit business experience.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and improving operational processes, standard operating procedures, and scalable service models.
  • Proven experience leading operational change, process improvement, and automation initiatives.
  • Experience working with multiple accounting ERP systems, such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics, QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle, Restaurant365, or similar.
  • Experience managing offshore or geographically distributed teams preferred.

Not sure you meet every qualification? Studies show that diverse applicants often hesitate to apply unless they check every box. At Buyers Edge Platform, we value authenticity and inclusion—if you're excited about the role, we encourage you to apply. You might be exactly who we’re looking for!

We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise-grade SBOM management, and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.

As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers, and our open-source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.

More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

Why this role is so important

Sonatype is a fast-growing software company helping companies manage their open-source software supply chains. As a subscription-based business, our success hinges on our ability to renew and expand existing customer accounts. Fortunately, our customers trust Sonatype and value our solutions. This trust is reflected in our 85%+ renewal rate—one of the highest in the software subscription industry. As we grow, we must maintain and even increase this rate.

    We are looking for a passionate, reliable, and highly competent Renewal Specialist. This position may be appealing if you’re early in your career, are a contracts/accounting specialist looking for a change, or are looking for a path to a customer-facing career.

Install the Engine. Scale the Machine.

This is not a typical "Head of Ops" role. This is a scale inflection role.

Emailable has been built founder-led. Now we're installing a revenue-focused operator to turn aggressive growth into a predictable machine.

If you've scaled a chaotic $5M–$25M ARR SaaS and know what breaks between scrappy and scalable, keep reading.

If you want comfort, skip this.

What We're Building

Emailable powers high-volume senders who live and die by inbox placement — Tech & SaaS, Ecommerce, Professional Services, Travel & Hospitality, Media & Publishing.

When deliverability drops, they bleed revenue. We're becoming the verification + deliverability infrastructure layer for that ecosystem.

This role is about making revenue predictable while we scale aggressively.

What You Own

You own the revenue engine. Not meetings. Not culture slides. Not "alignment." Revenue.

Specifically:

  • Forecast accuracy (±10%)
  • Pipeline discipline
  • Net Revenue Retention
  • Gross churn reduction
  • Enterprise expansion
  • Revenue visibility across the org

You will run sales, marketing, customer support, and engineering.

If revenue misses, it's on you. If we scale hard, you're the architect behind it.

Requirements

What This Role Is Not

  • Not corporate COO
  • Not process theater
  • Not a founder babysitter
  • Not maintenance mode

We want a builder. Someone who has:

  • Cleaned up messy CRMs
  • Killed fake optimism in forecasts
  • Reduced churn in usage-based SaaS
  • Installed discipline in scrappy teams
  • Worked directly with a driven founder

If you've only operated inside polished enterprise orgs, this likely isn't for you.

What Success Looks Like

By Day 90

  • Clean forecasting system
  • Clear segmentation
  • You running revenue meetings
  • Founder removed from operational noise

By 12 Months

  • Revenue predictable
  • Enterprise motion repeatable
  • NRR strong and stable
  • Internal execution tight

Long-Term

  • Scale toward eight figures
  • Revenue leadership under you installed
  • Infrastructure-level positioning in Media & Publishing

Who Thrives Here

You might be:

  • A VP Revenue at a growth-stage SaaS who's capped
  • A Head of RevOps already doing CRO-level work
  • A COO at a scrappy martech company
  • A former founder who learned revenue discipline the hard way

You are:

  • Calm under pressure
  • Direct
  • Comfortable challenging a CEO
  • Obsessed with numbers
  • Energized by growth

Benefits

  • Fully remote: globally distributed, optimized for deep work and autonomy
  • Competitive base + performance bonus
  • Flexible time off: no policies, no counting days
  • Home office & productivity budget
  • Professional development budget (courses, certs, conferences)
  • Family-friendly: paid parental leave, flexible schedules
  • Mental health & wellness support

If you want stability and incremental growth, this isn't for you.

If you want to build the revenue machine behind a category-defining infrastructure company, apply below or reach out directly.

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems for global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring a Jira Administrator to manage the Atlassian Jira Cloud at Canonical, including the administration, configuration, automation, and integration responsibilities. We expect the highest engineering quality, rigorous documentation practices, and effective stakeholder management abilities. Our goal is to enable Canonical engineering and business teams to leverage the power of Atlassian Jira, work on challenging assignments, and enable teams to make data-driven decisions.

The role is in the Commercial Systems team that integrates business systems used at Canonical to ensure reliable data flows at the right time to the right place, and to automate business processes across the company. We own a wide range of systems including popular SaaS solutions, such as Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, Greenhouse, GSuite, and a few dozen others. To achieve this goal, we leverage Python and Go in combination with open source tools, such as Airbyte and Temporal. Our work helps to make data-driven decisions, and increases the efficiency of business operations.

Location: This role can be held anywhere in EMEA time zones.

The role entails

  • Manage Atlassian Jira Cloud at Canonical
  • Design, document, and implement processes and automation in Jira
  • Design, document, and implement integrations between Jira and the data warehouse
  • Create analytical dashboards to enable stakeholders make data-driven decisions
  • Create learning resources that scale
  • Work with engineering, operations, and support teams at a global scale
  • Take ownership of critical escalations and resolve them in a timely manner

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Experience with Atlassian Jira and its ecosystem as an administrator
  • Understanding of common Jira usage patterns for various technical and non-technical departments
  • Experience as a software developer in Python
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Ability to collaborate remotely with a diverse set of team members and stakeholders, remain highly motivated, productive, and organized in a fully remote environment

Nice-to-have skills

What we offer colleagues

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

The Firefox Product Marketing team works closely with Product, Marketing, Creative and other cross-functional partners to drive acquisition, activation, engagement and retention across the entire user journey. The Lifecycle Marketing Operations Manager will serve as the operational anchor for Firefox Mobile marketing execution. They will translate product marketing and growth strategies into reliable, repeatable execution across App Store Optimization (ASO), lifecycle programs, product launches and other priority growth initiatives. They will also improve execution quality and team scalability by developing stronger processes, automation and AI-assisted workflows.

What you’ll do:

raw.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Full Stack Software Products
raw.excerpt: Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid.
raw.description:
Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low-cost electricity into always-on heat and power, without supply-constrained critical minerals or multi-year construction timelines.

We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low-cost energy.

About The Role

Antora Energy is looking for a full-stack product engineer to build the software products that power our business - from external customer experiences to internal tools used by teams across Business Development, Operations, and R&D.

In this role, you’ll help shape product vision, design the underlying data models, and connect AI systems with the business logic that makes them useful. You’ll own products end to end, working directly with users to understand their workflows, translate ambiguous needs into practical solutions, and ship software that performs reliably in production.

You’ll also help build Antora’s long-term software capabilities. That means creating systems, standards, and guardrails that allow partner teams to safely modify existing tools and build new ones within our ecosystem - without engineering becoming a bottleneck.

This is a highly autonomous role with direct influence over how software is designed and built at Antora. We’re looking for deep expertise in one or more core areas - such as software engineering, data modeling, AI integration, or product development - along with the curiosity and practical judgment to work across the full stack.

What You'll Do
Build Full-Stack Products

Design, build, deploy, and maintain internal and external software products across the frontend, backend, data, and AI layers. Own the complete product lifecycle, including architecture, observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance.


Enable Self-Service

Put workflow creation directly into users’ hands. Build systems that allow analysts, operators, and other domain experts to adapt their own tools without filing a ticket and waiting for engineering support.


Co-Create with Users

Work alongside the people doing the work. Learn their processes, build solutions with them, and give them the tools and confidence to continue improving those solutions independently.

When users contribute their own code or workflows, you’ll make those contributions safe to run, easy to review, and straightforward to maintain.

Establish a Unified Data Model

Design the data foundation that powers Antora’s products. Connect business systems, operational data, and plant telemetry through tested transformation pipelines and a governed semantic layer.

You’ll help ensure that critical concepts—such as revenue, availability, and delivered steam—have consistent definitions across dashboards, AI assistants, applications, and autonomous agents.

Design for Data Security

Build and enforce strong access controls for sensitive, proprietary, and counterparty-restricted data. Ensure every product, workflow, and AI interface consistently respects authorization boundaries.

At Antora, an AI system that answers an unauthorized question is not a clever feature—it is a business risk.

Build Proactive AI Guardrails

Make evaluation a core part of product development rather than a final checkpoint. Create systems that identify task failures, tool-calling errors, grounding gaps, security issues, and regressions before they reach users.

Where AI systems influence financial decisions, operational dispatch, or customer commitments, you’ll build safeguards that are rigorous, reliable, and easy for teams to use.

Set Engineering Standards

Help define architectural patterns, development practices, and technical guardrails across Antora’s software ecosystem. Distinguish between controls that prevent real failures and processes that create unnecessary friction.

What We're Looking For
  • Strong product judgment. You can turn vague, shifting requests into a clear product direction, write an effective specification, and ship a solution. You know how to challenge a feature request that misses the underlying problem while maintaining stakeholder trust.
  • Production software engineering experience. You have strong Python and TypeScript skills and are comfortable working across frontend and backend systems. You have owned applications end to end, including deployment, observability, reliability, and maintenance.
  • Experience shipping AI-powered products. You have built and deployed LLM-powered systems used by real users - and have learned from the unexpected ways those systems failed in production.
  • Strong data fundamentals. You are comfortable with SQL, warehouse modeling, and tools such as dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks. You have shipped data changes through CI and think proactively about data quality, freshness, lineage, and testing.
  • A collaborative approach to building. You have a track record of building with non-engineers, not simply building for them. You’re comfortable pairing, teaching, reviewing someone’s first pull request, and helping users become increasingly self-sufficient.
  • Clear cross-functional communication. You can connect product, data, AI, and software engineering considerations - and communicate technical decisions in a way that allows everyone in the room to contribute.
  • Practical risk judgment. You can distinguish between controls that prevent meaningful failures and ceremony that slows teams down. You know where users can safely make changes independently and where review or stronger governance is required.
  • A growth mindset. We do not expect one person to be an expert in every discipline. We value deep expertise, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a willingness to learn across the stack.
Bonus Qualifications
  • Experience building or maintaining semantic layers using tools such as dbt or Cube
  • Familiarity with ClickHouse, time-series data, or IoT systems
  • Experience with agent protocols such as MCP or with plugin and tool APIs
  • Background in energy, industrial technology, or manufacturing
  • Experience managing AI model usage, performance, and cost governance

Work Location: Remote / US based

Salary Range: $183-240k USD

Salary Basis:

Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. The actual salary offered will be within the posted range and determined based on several factors including but not limited to a candidate's experiences, credentials and expertise, as they pertain to the position's requirements.

In addition to a competitive base salary, Antora Energy’s Total Rewards program includes equity compensation in the form of stock options, a premium health benefits package with life and disability insurance, a 401K plan with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts, and an industry leading paid-time-off policy that features flexible and inclusive holiday observance, as well as paid volunteer time off.

When it comes to stopping climate change, we need everyone. We believe that having a diversity of backgrounds and experiences strengthens all of us, and we strive to create an environment where every one of us is empowered to create meaningful change.

About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate—we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Security Operations Engineer, Corporate Infrastructure to join our team. This is a Remote within the United States (with a hybrid preference for San Jose, CA) role, reporting to the Director - Zscaler on Zscaler in the Corporate Infrastructure department. As the operational backbone of the security team, you will keep policies tuned, alerts triaged, and platforms healthy while supporting Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX), AI Security, and Cloud Security (CSPM/DSPM) to mature our DevSecOps model.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Provide day-to-day operational support, configuration, policy tuning, and platform health monitoring for ZIA, ZPA, ZDX, AI Security, and Cloud Security
  • Configure and maintain zero trust policies covering user-to-application access, posture checking, SSL/TLS inspection, content filtering, and access control
  • Deploy and tune Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) policies, collaborating with environment owners on remediation
  • Utilize ZDX to monitor application and user experience issues, correlating findings with network and security telemetry to identify root causes
  • Support DLP policy tuning, alert triage, SOP documentation, and on-call incident response while helping automate repetitive workflows

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are a problem-solver. You seek out challenges because you are energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action, taking full accountability for security platform health with high integrity.
  • You are driven by innovation. You have a deep curiosity for how things work and leverage automation and AI tools to continuously improve security workflows.
  • You champion simplicity. You are skilled at distilling complex cloud, network, and security architectures into clear, simple, and actionable operational procedures.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You build strong cross-functional partnerships across environment owners, support teams, and product groups to drive security outcomes.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to specific customer security requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in IT security operations, network security, or a related technical domain
  • Hands-on experience administering Zscaler ZIA and/or ZPA security platforms
  • Working knowledge of zero trust concepts, including identity verification, role-based access control, network segmentation, and posture checking
  • Practical understanding of cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), OS fundamentals (Windows, macOS, Linux), networking concepts, and authentication protocols

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on configuration experience with SSL/TLS inspection, DLP, SIEM integration, log streaming (NSS), and EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Strong network troubleshooting skills utilizing tools like tcpdump, Wireshark, ping, and traceroute/MTR alongside familiarity with DevSecOps workflows
  • Active technical certifications such as Zscaler ZCCA/ZCCP, CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFR, Security+, or CISSP

Job Description
We are seeking a Senior Wallet Developer to design, build, and maintain secure, scalable wallet infrastructure for digital assets and financial systems. This role will work across backend services, wallet technology, external integrations, real-time systems, infrastructure, and emerging technologies.
  • Responsible for software development, systems integration, system design, and implementation of secure wallet infrastructure.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and wallet systems using technologies such as C#/.NET, Node.js, and TypeScript.
  • Design and implement secure wallet infrastructure, transaction workflows, and integrations with digital asset networks, financial systems, and external infrastructure partners such as Fireblocks and other custody and wallet service providers, with familiarity in Multi-Party Computation (MPC) technologies.

  • Build and maintain developer tools, internal services, and automation that improve engineering efficiency and system reliability.
  • Work with modern infrastructure and deployment technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, AWS, and cloud environments.
  • Apply a strong security-first approach to application development, wallet infrastructure, key management, access controls, cryptographic operations, and sensitive financial data.
  • Recommend system solutions by evaluating the security, scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability of different technologies and architectures.
  • Work with external technology and infrastructure partners to integrate wallet, custody, payment, blockchain, and financial services.
  • Support systems involving transaction processing, digital asset transfers, monitoring, confirmations, reconciliation, and real-time financial data.
  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies, software tools, and blockchain infrastructure to continuously improve wallet systems and engineering practices.

Role Summary

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help build the future of technical interviewing and assessment across CoderPad.

This is a fullstack role for someone who can move across backend services, frontend product surfaces, and AI-powered system design. You will work on user-facing features, production infrastructure, and internal engineering workflows where coding agents and AI-assisted development are part of normal day-to-day execution.

This role is remote from Latin America.

What You Will Work On

  • Build and ship fullstack product features across candidate and recruiter experiences, from API and data model design to frontend implementation.
  • Improve real-time AI-powered experiences used in interviews and assessments, including model orchestration, streaming UX, tool/function-calling patterns, and reliability.
  • Contribute to systems that integrate multiple LLM providers and require pragmatic handling of latency, cost, observability, and non-deterministic behavior.
  • Develop and improve deterministic internal tooling that helps engineers and agents execute work safely, repeatably, and with strong audibility.
  • Partner across product, design, and platform teams to take ambiguous problems from definition to production rollout.
  • Lead and mentor through code review, using reviews as both a quality gate and a coaching channel for less-experienced engineers.
  • Plan and deliver technical debt, architecture, and observability initiatives that improve long-term system maintainability.
  • Participate in on-call operations and drive runbook, reliability, and incident follow-up improvements.

Requirements

  • Senior-level experience shipping production software end-to-end in a fullstack capacity.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in at least one modern language and ecosystem, plus practical frontend experience with a component-based framework.
  • Proven ability to pick up unfamiliar stacks quickly and deliver in mixed-technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic development workflows (for example: Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent), including good judgment on delegation, context scoping, and review of AI-generated code.
  • Experience building production systems that use AI, such as LLM API integrations, prompt and context design, streaming responses, tool/function calling, and token or cost-aware engineering.
  • Significant contribution to code review, with evidence of raising code quality and mentoring peers through the review process.
  • Experience identifying and reducing technical debt, and contributing to architecture planning and documentation.
  • Proven ownership of production system health through monitoring/alerting improvements, incident response, and operational follow-through.
  • Experience partnering with product and technical leads on backlog preparation, scoping, sizing, and delivery planning.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals in testing, observability, debugging, and safe incremental delivery.
  • Clear written communication and collaborative ownership mindset in remote teams.

Desired Stack

You are not expected to know all of these technologies. Relevant equivalent experience is absolutely welcome.

  • Backend surfaces include Ruby on Rails, Java services, and Node/TypeScript services.
  • Frontend surfaces include React + TypeScript applications and shared web platform tooling.
  • AI systems include integrations across Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral families, with streaming and tool-calling capabilities.
  • Platform and infrastructure include PostgreSQL, GraphQL, Redis/Sidekiq, Firebase Realtime Database, Datadog, LaunchDarkly, GitLab CI, cloud services (AWS and GCP), and containerized execution environments.

How We Work

  • Remote-first collaboration across time zones with a strong written culture.

  • Documentation and operational clarity are part of shipping, not afterthoughts.

  • Operational ownership matters: we value engineers who improve on-call practices and close the loop after incidents.

WHO ARE WE?

We are the VMS Co-Op, a group of fast growing companies in the Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) space. The VMS Co-Op includes OLLY, SmartyPants and future acquisitions to come! This position's home company is OLLY.​

THE ROLE: DIRECTOR OF BRAND STRATEGY & BUSINESS GROWTH​

The Director of Brand Strategy & Business Growth leads OLLY's Brand Strategy Team and plays a critical role in turning business ambition into brand-driven growth. Working across OLLY's portfolio, this leader guides segment growth strategies, develops high-performing brand leaders, and connects consumer, commercial and operational perspectives into a unified plan for action. As a trusted partner to the VP of Brand Strategy& Innovation, they lead key strategic initiatives, diagnose business opportunities, and help ensure OLLY remains focused on the priorities that will drive disproportionate growth.​

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:​

Lead the Brand Strategy Organization​

  • Lead and develop OLLY's Brand Strategy team, building a high-performing organization capable of driving both brand health and business growth. Coach and develop segment leaders to operate as owners of their businesses, creating accountability for performance, strategic rigor, and cross-functional leadership. Foster collaboration across segments while ensuring resources and focus are directed toward OLLY's greatest growth opportunities.​

Drive Segment & Portfolio Growth Strategy​

  • Partner with Brand Managers to develop clear growth strategies for OLLY's core business segments. Translate consumer insights, category dynamics, marketplace trends, and business objectives into actionable growth plans. Identify the most significant opportunities, barriers, and strategic choices that will shape the future of OLLY, while ensuring segment strategies ladder into a cohesive growth agenda.​

Put the Brand at the Center of the Business​

  • Serve as the steward of the OLLY brand, ensuring consumer and brand strategy inform decisions across Marketing, Media, Commercial,Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Innovation. Build organizational alignment around who we serve, what the brand stands for, where future growth will come from, and what matters most to win. Connect functional strategies into one integrated brand and business growth plan.​

Lead Business Performance & Growth Management​

  • Own a comprehensive view of business performance across revenue, share, household penetration, velocity, distribution, repeat, pricing, mix, and profitability. Diagnose underlying drivers of performance, identify emerging opportunities and risks, establish clear KPIs, and ensure segment and portfolio strategies evolve based on business results.​

Lead Strategic Initiatives & Special Projects​

  • Partner closely with the VP of Brand Strategy & Innovation to lead high-impact, cross-functional projects that accelerate growth, improve organizational effectiveness, unlock new capabilities, or address critical business opportunities. Provide structured problem-solving, strategic analysis, and leadership to move priorities from concept to action.​

Strategic Leadership & Organizational Influence​

  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the VP of Brand Strategy & Innovation and a key connector across the organization. Elevate strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and growth management capabilities across teams. Build alignment around priorities, drive decision-making with data and consumer insights, and ensure the organization remains focused on the initiatives that will create disproportionate impact.​

THE CANDIDATE​

14+ years of experience across brand management, brand strategy, business strategy, commercial strategy, general management, or growth leadership, ideally with experience in ecommerce and media. This leader combines strong brand and consumer thinking with commercial and financial acumen, understanding how to translate insights into growth strategies that drive business performance.​

They understand that brand strategy cannot live in a silo. They ensure that what the brand stands for, who it serves, and where it has the greatest right to win informs decisions across media investment, customer strategy, innovation, commercial planning, forecasting, demand planning, and operations. They are equally comfortable shaping long-term growth strategies, diagnosing business performance, and leading cross-functional teams against the company's highest-priority opportunities.​

Strong analytical and financial acumen, coupled with a proven track record of developing talent, influencing senior leaders, and building alignment across complex organizations.​

CAPABILITIES + SKILLS REQUIRED​

  • Experience partnering across Marketing, Media, Sales, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Innovation.​
  • Strong understanding of forecasting, demand planning, annual business planning, and portfolio management processes.​
  • Ability to connect consumer insights, brand health, commercial performance, and financial results to inform growth strategies and business decisions.​
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional teams around a common vision, priorities, and growth agenda.​
  • Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams, fostering strong business ownership, accountability, and strategic thinking.​
  • Comfortable moving seamlessly between long-term strategic planning, complex problem-solving, and detailed business analysis.​
  • Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive high-impact projects from insight to execution.​
  • Highly collaborative, curious, commercially minded, and action-oriented.​

WHAT TO EXPECT DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Initial video screen with a member of our Talent team
  • Round 1: Conversation with the Hiring Manager + 1-2 conversations with other Ollies on the team
  • Round 2: 2-3 conversations with team or cross functional Ollies
  • Final Round: Homework*

*At OLLY, our final round is called Homework. Candidates who participate in this round are given 3 questions in advance to answer and present to the interview panel they previously spoke with in the process. We understand every candidate is different. If you need a reasonable accommodation to adjust this procedure, please let us know as soon as possible so that we can evaluate and provide other options that work for your needs

THE DETAILS

​LOCATION: Remote, USA - 4X travel per year to company offsites​

HOURS: Full time, exempt (salary)​

MANAGER: VP of Brand Strategy & Innovation​

PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

The base pay range for this position is $182,700 - 223,300. For this remote role, compensation is determined based on geographic location and experience, and the final offer will reflect these factors within the posted range.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • An opportunity to work with an intelligent, inspiring, and extraordinarily fun team
  • We pay 100% of the premiums for employee-only medical, dental + orthodontics, and vision insurance
  • 4 weeks PTO + paid holidays + 12 Mental Health Days per year
  • 100% Paid parental leave, Fertility + Adoption Benefits
  • Annual Bonus
  • 401(k) plan with Employer Match
  • Hybrid Work + Wellness + Cell Phone Stipends
  • Free product
  • And much more!

Salary: £35,000 - £45,000 depending on experience.

Location: Remote-first, flexible working arrangements, with all UK-based locations considered. Our flexible office collaboration spaces, for those wishing to use them, are in London, Exeter, Birmingham and Bristol.

Term: Permanent, full-time (up to 40 hours per week). Reduced hours and flexible working patterns may be considered. Please state any requirements or preferences in your application.

Grade: Consultant.

Closing Date: 13th September 2026. Applications for this position may close early if a suitable candidate is found before the closing date. Early application is recommended.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of sex, gender identity, age, disability, ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

We are only accepting direct applications (no recruiters please).

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applications requiring visa sponsorship now, or in the future.

ABOUT CITY SCIENCE

City Science was founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently. We work collaboratively across our business to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes major bodies such as DESNZ, the Climate Change Committee (CCC), and a range of forward-thinking local authorities. Our business includes award-winning research, software and product development teams who produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like our GIS software, Cadence, to successfully deliver our projects.

Our Energy & Environment team leads complex consulting commissions across a broad range of technical disciplines and technologies. Examples of the projects we deliver includes:

  • District Heat Network studies (we are a supplier on the Heat Network Zoning DESNZ framework)

  • Local Area Energy Plans (LAEP) and Local Heat & Energy Efficiency Strategies (LHEES)

  • Renewable & Low Carbon Energy Assessments

  • Alternative Fuel Strategies (e.g. Hydrogen, SAF) and Industrial Decarbonisation

  • Technology specific research (such as our DACCS work for the Climate Change Committee)

Further information about some example projects we have delivered can be found on our website.

ABOUT THE ROLE

City Science is seeking a Consultant level candidate who can support delivery of our broad range of consulting commissions in our Energy & Environment Team.

We are particularly interested in candidates with a technical background (e.g. physical sciences or engineering), or those with an economics/finance background but with experience of applying these skills to the energy and low-carbon sectors.

Whilst our preference is for candidates with professional experience (2+ years), we encourage applications from those who have recently completed a relevant PhD. Experience in areas such as district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), local area energy plans, community energy and renewable energy is highly desirable.

You will contribute to the delivery of projects via research, report writing, analysis, and the production of models. Whilst a key requirement of this role is technical proficiency, we also have an expectation that you will contribute to common consultancy non-technical tasks such as project management, bid writing, stakeholder engagement, and client relationship management. We are a small consultancy, and everyone contributes across a range of activities, supports the achievement of business objectives, and helps identify future opportunities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Consultant within City Science’s Energy & Environment team, you will be responsible for:

· Research, modelling, and analysis across a range of energy and net zero projects

· Data analysis (in Excel predominantly).

· Producing high quality reports and presentations for clients

· Supporting business development and the winning of new work, including preparing proposals, identifying new opportunities and promoting our business.

· Providing quality assurance for projects and technical deliverables

· Build and maintain strong client relationships.

Requirements

ABOUT YOU

You’re motivated, proactive and customer-focused with exceptional attention to detail and the needs of our clients. You have broad technical knowledge and a genuine interest in decarbonisation, sustainability and low carbon solutions.

You’re a great collaborator, committed to the success of the team, with the flexibility to intelligently adapt to the task at hand. Most importantly, you are motivated to deliver high-quality work, solve complex problems and contribute positively to the success of the team.

Essential Requirements

· 2+ years of relevant work experience, or a PhD.

· Degree qualified in a STEM subject, or degree qualified in economics/finance with experience of applying those skills to decarbonisation or sustainability projects and technologies.

· Demonstrable knowledge and understanding across the energy and environment sectors.

· Strong Excel skills and data visualisation capabilities.

· Independent problem solving and ability to develop structured approaches.

· Ability to efficiently produce high-quality reports and documents.

· Ability to communicate technical outputs to a range of technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable

· A PhD, or Master’s degree in finance or a relevant technical discipline.

· Chartered status or working towards chartership.

· Completed project management qualifications (e.g. PRINCE2, APM).

· Knowledge and experience of GIS and coding (e.g. Python).

· Experience of working in a consultancy environment.

· Experience of one or more of: district heat networks, carbon accounting (particularly scope 3 emissions), energy system modelling, local area energy planning, or net zero financing.

If you're excited by this opportunity but don't meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We recognise that relevant skills and experience can be developed through different routes.

REWARDS & BENEFITS

This role offers:

· The opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across our consultancy business.

· The opportunity for career progression.

· Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership).

· Paid membership of one professional institution.

· Flexible working arrangements.

· 25 days annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays, and ability to buy a further 5 days.

· Membership of our group pension scheme.

· Enhanced maternity and paternity policy.

· Eye care vouchers.

· Cycle to work scheme.

· Employee assistance programme.

FURTHER INFORMATION
We are building a team that is motivated by collaboration and a desire to solve problems for our customers. We want people to take ownership of their area of responsibility, make informed decisions, be proactive and take pride in their work.

Highlights

City Science is seeking a Consultant level candidate who can support delivery of our broad range of consulting commissions in our Energy & Environment Team.

raw.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced QA Fullstack Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites across API (REST Assured), web UI (Selenide), and mobile (Appium) layers;
  • Perform manual testing where required, including mobile-specific scenarios (responsiveness, permissions, OS/version coverage, lifecycle testing);
  • Analyze application logs to identify, localize, and help troubleshoot defects;
  • Represent and enforce testing principles within the assigned development team, contributing to the team's overall quality assurance mindset;
  • Where applicable, contribute to accessibility (A11Y) testing efforts;
  • Conduct performance/load testing using JMeter and provide optimization recommendations based on results.

Requirements

  • Manual Testing

- API testing: ability to read API specifications/documentation, independently build a test collection, and test a service using any common tool (Postman, Insomnia, SoapUI, etc.);

- Log analysis: ability to read logs and independently identify or localize defects;

- Mobile testing: familiarity with mobile-specific testing tasks — responsiveness, permissions handling, screen size/OS version coverage, application lifecycle testing.

  • Automation

- Java: confident, object-oriented programming skills; experience building test automation frameworks from scratch; clean, reusable code; familiarity with JUnit, TestNG, Maven/Gradle;

- REST Assured: automated REST API testing; solid grasp of HTTP methods, status codes, JSON, authentication; able to write and parameterize complex API test cases; integration with JUnit/TestNG;

- Selenide: automated UI testing for web applications; knowledge of the Page Object Model; stable, maintainable tests for dynamic interfaces; integration with JUnit/TestNG;

- Appium: automated mobile testing (Android/iOS); experience with emulators/simulators; native and hybrid app testing; CI/CD integration.

Would be a plus:- A11Y (accessibility) testing: awareness of inclusive design principles, WCAG Level A requirements, and practical use of accessibility tools (TalkBack, VoiceOver, NVDA, or JAWS);

- JMeter: performance/load testing; familiarity with Thread Group, Sampler, Listener, Assertion components; ability to load-test APIs, databases, and web applications; results analysis and optimization recommendations.
