About Sylvan Health:

At Sylvan Health, we believe nutrition is foundational to better health outcomes. We partner with healthcare organizations to connect patients with virtual nutrition care and support delivered by experienced Registered Dietitians. Our Engagement Specialists play a critical role in creating a positive, supportive first experience for patients entering our programs.

Position Overview:

This is a 6-month contract position for up to 30 hours per week, with the potential for extension based on business needs and performance.

The Engagement Specialist I serves as the first point of contact for patients and caregivers engaging with Sylvan Health and plays a key role in enrolling patients into our nutrition support program. This role is responsible for educating patients about the program, scheduling telehealth appointments with our Registered Dietitians, and assisting with rescheduling and basic technical support needs. The ideal candidate is empathetic, highly organized, adaptable, and comfortable communicating across multiple channels including phone, SMS, email, and patient portals.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as the initial point of contact for patients and caregivers
  • Build rapport and establish trusting relationships with patients and families
  • Make outbound calls to educate patients about Sylvan Health programs and assist with enrollment; schedule telehealth initial and follow-up visits with Registered Dietitians
  • Support patients with questions related to scheduling, telehealth visits, and general insurance concepts
  • Send follow-up communications through phone calls, SMS, email, and patient portal messaging
  • Provide timely support for inbound patient communications, including appointment adjustments and visit transfers
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and empathy during every patient interaction
  • Collaborate closely with Registered Dietitians and other care team members
  • Document patient interactions accurately within EMR and CRM systems
  • Resolve patient and caregiver questions professionally and efficiently
  • Navigate multiple systems and workflows simultaneously in a detail-oriented manner

Requirements

  • Legally Authorized to work in the U.S.
  • 2+ years of experience in a patient-facing or healthcare communication role; examples include: Care Coordination, Patient scheduling, Healthcare customer support
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to connect with individuals from diverse backgrounds and varying levels of health literacy
  • Demonstrated ability to manage sensitive, complex, or fast-moving situations in real time
  • Working knowledge of the U.S. healthcare system, including:
    • Provider visit types and care pathways
    • Basic insurance concepts such as deductibles, coverage, and in-network vs. out-of-network care
    • General patient navigation workflows
  • Ability to communicate clearly and confidently across phone, SMS, and email
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable adapting to evolving workflows and operational processes
  • Ability to work efficiently across multiple software systems simultaneously
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required
  • Helpful but not required: Previous experience or working knowledge in nutrition or Medical Nutrition Therapy space

Benefits

  • This is a 1099 Contractor remote role.

raw.description:
About the Team

Our Connected Customer Experiences organization is scaling a portfolio of AI-powered capabilities designed to help customers resolve issues quickly and effectively, with AI increasingly able to complete resolutions without requiring human involvement. These capabilities are core to how ServiceNow proves that AI can operate reliably at enterprise scale — on our own platform, for our own customers.

About the Role

ServiceNow is looking for a Principal Inbound Product Manager to build the evaluation and feedback backbone that makes our AI-powered support products trustworthy, measurable, and continuously improving. We are investing in building structured mechanism for statistical sampling, human review, or feedback capture that closes the loop back into the product. This role owns enabling that mechanism from the ground up, and applying it consistently across all AI-enabled products in the portfolio.

This is an inbound-facing role: your primary customers are the product teams and Customer Support teams across the organization, and your core deliverable is the evaluation & governance infrastructure, taxonomy, and process that lets every AI feature get measurably better over time.

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end design of the AI product evaluation ecosystem: automated evals, human-in-the-loop review, and a structured feedback taxonomy applied consistently across the organization's AI-enabled support capabilities.
  • A closed-loop process that converts feedback and review findings into concrete product and model improvements.
  • Cross-functional coordination across Product, AI/ML Engineering, Data & Telemetry, and AI Operations to unify how feedback is captured, reviewed, and actioned.
  • The requirements and prioritization inputs that drive continuous improvement in resolution quality and effectiveness, benefiting both internal support teams and external customers.

Why This Role Matters

  • Own the foundational trust layer for ServiceNow's AI-powered support products at a moment when the company is scaling AI features faster than it can currently validate them.
  • Shape how ServiceNow itself, not just our customers — operationalizes responsible, data-driven AI product development, with direct executive visibility.
  • Sit at the intersection of product, data science, and operations, with the mandate to build something that doesn't exist today rather than optimize an existing process.

  • High-leverage, cross-functional scope: your work becomes the shared standard every AI feature across the org and measured against.

What Success Looks Like

  • A structured evaluation ecosystem (automated evals, human review cadence, feedback taxonomy) live and adopted across all major AI-enabled support products.
  • A functioning closed-loop process, with measurable improvement in resolution quality tied to feedback findings.
  • Demonstrated progress toward company-wide goals for AI-driven issue resolution, with feedback insights as a contributing driver.
  • AI product and engineering teams actively using the evaluation framework as part of their standard development cycle, not as an afterthought.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • 15+ years of product management , with recent hands-on experience building AI Agents, AI evaluation, feedback, or quality frameworks for AI/ML-powered products.
  • Strong AI product sense, able to reason about measuring AI application performance, failure modes, and quality tradeoffs, not just feature delivery.
  • Experience designing structured feedback or evaluation systems: golden datasets, statistical sampling, human-in-the-loop review, or similar.
  • Data-driven decision-making, comfortable defining metrics, interpreting telemetry, and using both to prioritize.
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional initiatives without direct authority, across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations.
  • Experience in a customer support, service delivery, or similarly operational environment is a plus.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; able to influence senior leaders and align multiple teams around a shared framework.

Accommodations

raw.description:
eClinical Solutions helps life sciences organizations around the world accelerate clinical development initiatives with expert data services and the elluminate Clinical Data Cloud – the foundation of digital trials. Together, the elluminate platform and digital data services give clients self-service access to all their data from one centralized location plus advanced analytics that help them make smarter, faster business decisions.

OVERVIEW

The Principals Biostatisticians will work closely with clients and provide high level consulting services for statistical analysis, reporting, and statistical programming specific activities which may include development of statistics section of protocol, development of statistical analysis plan, randomization schedule, conducting statistical analyses, validating programming and reporting output, and developing statistical analysis report. Principal Biostatisticians will also work on statistical programming for development of analysis datasets, and clinical tables, listings, and graphs specific to trial reporting requirements. Principal Biostatisticians will work as needed assuring that all client work has met or exceeded client expectations.

Accelerate your skills and career within a fast-growing company while impacting the future of healthcare. 

Your day to day:

  • Provide consulting of statistics activities related to clinical trials. Fulfill the responsibilities of study statistician as required
  • Provide mentoring and QC of statistical programmer’s outputs; define analysis data specifications. If required, validate the statistical models used for programming
  • Act as study statistician - interact with client and with clinical team including programmers, clinical data managers, clinical protocol manager, and other relevant personnel. Ensure that programmers get correct specifications and data at appropriate time
  • Develop, review, and finalize the statistical analysis plan
  • Validate the programming deliverables and collaborate with applicable team members to rectify any issues related to statistical reporting and analysis
  • Develop randomization schedule, specifications, and guidelines
  • Wherever applicable, provide input in finalization of study specific data quality control plan and ensure appropriate data analysis and reporting
  • Wherever applicable, develop, validate and finalize the study specific list of table and table shells for clinical study reports and for study specific deliverables
  • Ensure that all comments from the clinical team with regards to statistical report delivered for study specific deliverables are being addressed appropriately
  • Analyze the data and contribute to trial progression related decisions by providing necessary input during trial specific deliverables including but not limited to blinded data reviews, and interim analyses
  • Collaborate with team members for regulatory reviews, representations, and supporting data analyses including the study or compound level exploratory analyses, ad-hoc analyses, and post- hoc analyses
  • Develop SAS programs to generate analysis datasets, and trial specific reporting including but not limited to tables, listings, graphs, queries, and patient profile reports
  • Ensure compliance with eClinical Solutions and industry quality standards, guidelines and procedures
  • Other duties as assigned

Take the first step towards your dream career. Here is what we are looking for in this role. 

Qualifications:

  • Master in Statistics or biostatistics preferred
  • SAS® certification is preferred
  • 10+ years in Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology industry or equivalent statistical consulting and SAS programming role preferred
  • Strong experience with clinical study design development, analysis, and sample size determination
  • Experience with development of randomization schedule including development of IVRS specifications, and guidelines for appropriate usage of randomization schedule
  • Excellent knowledge of English and with clear, concise, and accurate communications, both written and verbal
  • Detail oriented, ability to multitask with strong prioritization, planning and organization skills
  • Ability and experience of delegating tasks and leading projects. Experience of working on multiple clinical protocols at the same time
  • Ability to balance conflicting priorities
  • Strong knowledge of ICH guidelines and other guidelines such as GCP, and 21 CFR Part 11 from different regulatory agencies including FDA, and EMEA
  • Experience in developing statistical analyses reports, and in conducting statistical analyses and reporting for various trial level deliverables including but not limited to blinded data reviews, interim analyses
  • Knowledge of coding dictionaries (WHO, COSTART, ICD-9, MedDRA) and clinical reporting processes
  • Knowledge of CDISC® related data models such as SDTM, and ADAM. Ability to develop ADAM model for analysis and reporting of clinical trial. Through understanding of SDTM data structures

AI is intended to augment—not replace—professional judgment, critical thinking, accountability, and decision-making. Accountability for all work remains with the employee.

What success looks like in this role:

Job Profile Summary

Serves as a senior technical leader responsible for the strategy, architecture, design, implementation, and governance of enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) capabilities across infrastructure, applications, cloud platforms, and data environments.

Partners with business and technology leadership to ensure resilience of mission-critical systems through development, testing, and execution of Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs) aligned to recovery objectives (RTO/RPO). Provides leadership and coordination across internal teams and third-party providers to ensure rapid restoration of services during disaster events.

---

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy & Design

  • Defines enterprise Disaster Recovery architecture, standards, and frameworks aligned with ITIL/ITSM Service Continuity Management practices.
  • Develops resilient architectures across cloud, infrastructure, and applications, including failover, redundancy, and replication strategies.
  • Translates business requirements and Business Impact Analysis (BIA) into DR technical solutions and architecture designs.

---

Disaster Recovery Planning & Governance

  • Leads development, maintenance, and governance of Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), including application-specific recovery strategies.
  • Ensures DRPs align with defined Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
  • Establishes governance processes to maintain DRP accuracy through change management and annual review cycles.
  • Conducts gap analysis and recommends improvements to DR processes, technologies, and services.

---

Cross-Functional Leadership & Coordination

  • Provides leadership and oversight for Disaster Recovery activities across internal teams and third-party providers.
  • Facilitates DR planning and execution coordination across business, infrastructure, and application teams.
  • Acts as the primary technical authority for DR architecture and recovery strategy decisions.

---

Disaster Recovery Readiness

  • Defines infrastructure, network, and data protection requirements necessary for DR execution.
  • Designs and governs backup, replication, and recovery strategies to ensure system recoverability and data integrity.
  • Ensures DR environments are maintained in alignment with production configurations.

---

Testing & Validation

  • Leads planning, execution, and reporting of Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Coordinates participation across internal teams and third-party providers during DR tests.
  • Analyzes results, identifies gaps, and drives remediation actions.

---

Disaster Recovery Execution

  • Provides technical leadership during disaster events and ensures execution of DRPs.
  • Coordinates failover to DR sites and restoration of mission-critical systems.
  • Leads post-incident analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Qualifications

Education

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field

· Preferred: Master’s degree

Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in IT architecture, infrastructure, or enterprise systems
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing enterprise Disaster Recovery solutions
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, hybrid environments)

---

Skills

Core Technical Skills

  • Disaster Recovery Architecture & Strategy

· High Availability & Resiliency Design

  • Backup, Replication, and Data Protection
  • Cloud Architecture (AWS, Azure, Hybrid)
  • Enterprise Architecture & Solution Design

· Infrastructure & Platform Engineering

Operational & Governance Skills

  • ITIL / ITSM Service Continuity Management

· Incident & Crisis Management

· Risk Management & Compliance

· Change Management Integration

· Vendor & Third-Party Coordination

---

Certifications

  • ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor (Business Continuity)
  • Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP)
  • Certified Disaster Recovery Engineer (CDRE)
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert (including Azure Site Recovery)

· ITIL Foundation or higher

---

Competencies

  • Architecture Principles & Design (Advanced)

· Security & Risk Management (Advanced)

  • System & Technology Integration (Advanced)

· Cloud Computing (Advanced)

· Incident Management (Advanced)

· Infrastructure Design (Advanced)

· Strategic Thinking & Vision (Advanced)

  • Business Continuity & Resilience Leadership (Advanced) (added)
  • Crisis Decision Making (Advanced) (added)

---

Impact / Accountability Statement

Accountable for ensuring enterprise resilience and service continuity by establishing and governing Disaster Recovery strategies, architectures, and operational execution. Enables rapid recovery of mission-critical systems, minimizes business disruption, and drives continuous improvement in organizational recovery capabilities.

We are looking for an experienced Software Architect. In this role, you will define the technical vision for new products and technology initiatives, evaluate emerging technologies, design modern architectural solutions, and help engineering teams transform ideas into scalable, production-ready products.

This role requires a combination of architectural expertise, strong hands-on engineering experience, and a technology-driven mindset. You will drive technology strategy, evaluate new approaches, lead Proof of Concept initiatives, and make key architectural decisions that shape the future of our products and platforms.

This is a remote role.

Responsibilities

  • Research emerging technologies, conduct technical evaluations, and drive Proof of Concept initiatives.
  • Design scalable cloud-native, distributed, and hybrid architectures.
  • Establish architectural standards, best practices, and engineering guidelines.
  • Lead the technical design of complex enterprise and high-load systems.
  • Define technology stacks and architectural principles for new solutions.
  • Contribute to innovative solutions leveraging modern technologies, including AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM, and intelligent automation.
  • Identify technical risks and define mitigation strategies.
  • Support engineering teams in solving complex technical challenges and making key architectural decisions.
  • Conduct architecture reviews and technical solution assessments.
  • Contribute to technical strategy, product roadmaps, and long-term product evolution.
  • Support technology transformation and product modernization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders on architecture and technology strategy topics.
  • Mentor technical leads and senior engineers.
  • Help shape engineering culture, development processes, and DevOps practices.

Architecture Expertise

  • Significant experience in software development, architecture, and evolution of products, platforms, and enterprise solutions.
  • 4+ years in a Software Architect, Enterprise Architect, Engineering Director, or similar architectural role.
  • Strong understanding of modern architectural patterns, software design principles, and distributed systems.
  • Defining architectural vision and driving strategic technology decisions.
  • Evaluating technologies and architectural approaches based on business goals, scalability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and long-term sustainability.

Technology Leadership Expertise

  • Leading distributed engineering teams and technical initiatives.
  • Driving architectural initiatives across products, platforms, or teams.
  • Collaborating with engineering, product, and business stakeholders.
  • Defining architectural standards and engineering best practices.

Cloud & Platform Architecture Expertise

  • Designing cloud-native, distributed, and scalable systems.
  • AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.
  • Architecting highly available, resilient, enterprise-grade solutions.
  • Kubernetes and container technologies.
  • Microservices, Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, and API-First Design.

Engineering Expertise

  • Strong hands-on software development background.
  • Experience with modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automation, and DevOps.
  • Experience with modern programming languages, cloud technologies, and enterprise platforms.
  • End-to-end product and platform delivery

Technology Stack
Practical expertise across a combination of the following technology domains:

  • Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
  • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker, Helm
  • Programming Languages: Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, Nodejs
  • Frontend Technologies: React, Angular, or similar modern frontend frameworks
  • Data & Messaging Technologies: PostgreSQL, Oracle, MS SQL Server, NoSQL, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Automation: GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code
  • Observability & Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, OpenTelemetry

Nice to Have

  • Practical experience with AI/ML, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, or intelligent automation.
  • Professional certifications in architecture, cloud platforms, or software engineering.

We offer:

  • Culture of relentless performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive pay and benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
  • ForeverRemote work culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming multicultural environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social sustainability values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

raw.description:
The Team

Service Delivery is the backbone of ServiceNow's customer success strategy in the Americas. We manage the governance, performance, and strategic alignment of our global system integrator (SI) and service delivery partners ensuring that partner-delivered services meet the highest standards of quality, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes. The Service Delivery function spans partner capacity planning, contingent worker onboarding, contract management, resource optimization, and end-to-end delivery governance across a large ecosystem of delivery partners serving thousands of customers.

As a Service Delivery Manager, you will be part of a team supporting the Director, Service Delivery in executing the regional service delivery strategy and governance frameworks. Your focus will be on the tactical, day-to-day oversight and governance of assigned partner engagements, ensuring consistent execution of ServiceNow standards, quality metrics, and customer outcomes.

The Role

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing the performance, quality, and operational health of assigned partners. Acting as the primary governance point between ServiceNow and delivery partner(s) for your assigned portfolio, you ensure partner resources assigned to ServiceNow engagements are delivered in accordance with agreed service levels, quality standards, contractual commitments, and customer outcome expectations.

You monitor service delivery performance, identify risks, drive corrective actions, manage escalations, and provide ongoing visibility into delivery health for leadership. Your role serves as the critical accountability layer that makes partner performance predictable, scalable, and aligned to ServiceNow standards across your assigned partners, regardless of whether they are delivering managed services, outsourced operations, subcontracted services, or project-based engagements. You work closely with the Director, Service Delivery to implement governance processes, contribute to strategic initiatives, and escalate systemic issues that require regional leadership attention.

Responsibilities

Partner Performance Governance

  • Serve as the primary ServiceNow point of contact for assigned partner points of contact; maintaining day-to-day oversight of partner service performance against contracted KPIs and SLAs.
  • Monitor service delivery performance across assigned partners, tracking key metrics including quality scores, customer satisfaction, utilization rates, delivery timelines, and cost-per-outcome performance; ensuring that ServiceNow and its customers are getting excellence in delivery from its partner resources.
  • Review delivery quality trends, audit findings, and operational metrics to identify systemic issues, root causes, and opportunities for continuous improvement within assigned portfolio.
  • Monitor delivery unit economics and cost-per-outcome performance, ensuring the contracted commercial model (unit-based, outcome-based, or hybrid) tracks to delivered value and flag discrepancies.
  • Maintain a dashboard or reporting view of assigned partner health metrics and escalate systemic issues to the Director, Service Delivery for strategic resolution or cross-regional alignment.

Escalation & Corrective Action

  • Lead delivery escalations across ServiceNow and partner teams for assigned engagements, driving timely issue resolution and ensuring accountability for remediation plans and service recovery activities.
  • Document escalation history, track resolution status, and report escalation trends to the Director, Service Delivery and relevant stakeholders.
  • Identify patterns in escalations across assigned partners and recommend process improvements or capability enhancements to the Director.
  • Partner with customer success teams and account teams to protect customer outcomes and address service delivery risks impacting customer health.

Onboarding & Service Transitions

  • Own tracking and acceptance of transition and mobilization milestones during partner onboarding or service transitions, including staffing ramp against plan, capability/certification readiness, and transition exit criteria.
  • Ensure partner resource skills and certifications align with service demands and customer requirements, tracking ongoing development and readiness.
  • Communicate onboarding milestones and status to leadership and document lessons learned from transitions.
  • Support the Director in partner capacity planning by tracking staffing ramps, utilization, and capability readiness for assigned partners.

Operational Governance & Reporting

  • Manage the operational governance cadence for assigned partners, including weekly performance check-ins, monthly reviews, and quarterly business review preparation.
  • Own capacity and demand management processes for assigned partners, including utilization tracking, variance planning, and periodic reconciliation against contracted volumes.
  • Manage the change control process for operational or initiative requests that have contractual implications, engaging Commercial Management as needed.
  • Flag discrepancies between service delivery status and invoicing or milestone payment triggers to Commercial and Finance stakeholders.
  • Produce and maintain performance reporting for assigned partners, providing regular updates to the Director and internal leadership stakeholders.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in response to changes in tooling, operating model, or service delivery requirements.

Collaboration & Coordination

  • Coordinate with other Service Delivery Managers in the region and across geographies on initiative design, sequencing, and rollout to ensure consistency.
  • Maintain regular interlock with the Global Partnerships and Channels (GPC) team, ensuring partner performance insights, escalations, and capability needs are escalated appropriately.
  • Support the Director in implementing regional governance frameworks and standard operating procedures across partner-delivered services.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives with Commercial Management, Finance, Sales, and Customer Excellence Group to support partner relationship development.

Core Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in service delivery management, vendor governance, partner performance management, or a related operational role within a global technology or SaaS environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing partner, vendor, or supplier performance through structured governance frameworks, scorecards, and business reviews.
  • Proven ability to manage third-party performance against defined SLAs and KPIs, including escalation and corrective action processes.
  • Experience managing partners in a Customer Success and Professional Services delivery context.
  • Track record of driving continuous improvement and service efficiencies in partner or vendor management environments.

Operational & Functional Skills

  • Experience designing and maintaining operational documentation, including playbooks and standard operating procedures.
  • Strong project and program management capability, with a track record of delivering cross-functional initiatives to agreed timelines.
  • Proficiency in performance data analysis and reporting, with the ability to draw actionable conclusions from KPI and operational metrics.
  • Experience monitoring and tracking partner resource ongoing development of skills and certifications in line with service demands.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions and levels of seniority without direct line authority.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and presentation skills with ability to clearly articulate performance insights to partner leadership and internal stakeholders.

ServiceNow & Domain Knowledge

  • Knowledge of, or ability to rapidly develop proficiency in, ServiceNow's platform and products.
  • Familiarity with Customer Success and Professional Services metrics and post-sales operating models, including NPS, utilization, rate cards, and product adoption measures.
  • Understanding of professional services delivery models, partner economics, and how partner governance supports customer outcomes.
  • Ability to balance customer outcomes, business objectives, and partner performance requirements in a complex operating environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within or alongside a Partner or managed service delivery model, particularly in a vendor governance or service integration capacity.
  • Familiarity with scaled SaaS operating models, AI Native environments, and partner-delivered service motions.
  • Experience operating within an organizational transformation or operational improvement program in a post-sales or customer success context.
  • Certifications in relevant disciplines (e.g., PMP, ITIL, CSM, COPC, supplier management).
  • Exposure to AI-enabled or agentic workflow tooling within an operational team environment.
  • Experience with India-based or nearshore service delivery models and geographically distributed partner teams.
  • Prior experience at ServiceNow or within the ServiceNow ecosystem.

FD21

Affirm is reinventing credit to make it more honest and friendly, giving consumers the flexibility to buy now and pay later without any hidden fees or compounding interest.

About the Revenue team

The Revenue team drives Affirm’s top-line growth through strategic partnerships, pricing, and go-to-market execution. We acquire, retain, and expand merchant relationships across eCommerce, in-store, telesales, and the Affirm app. The team leads onboarding, relationship management, and performance optimization to help partners succeed. We deliver value-added solutions, drive adoption, and support long-term business growth by connecting merchants and consumers through Affirm’s products.

About the Role

GTM Strategy & Operations takes product and pricing initiatives and creates commercially viable, operationally sound go-to-market motions. We partner with Product, Product Marketing, Legal, Rev Ops, and Pricing to design rollout groups, coordinate implementation, and equip the field — CSMs, AEs, and TAMs — with the processes they need to create world-class go-to-market. As an individual contributor, the Lead owns the go-to-market for a specific product line or segment end to end. You're handed the objective ("drive adoption for this new feature") and you decide how: the rollout plan, the enablement, the tracking. You turn half-formed product and pricing inputs into a plan a rep can actually execute.

What You'll Do

  • Own the go-to-market for a product line or segment end to end — rollout design, enablement, and the adoption target you're driving toward.

  • Turn inputs from cross-functional stakeholders like Product, Pricing, and PMM into a coherent GTM strategy, and track adoption against goal.

  • Fluently navigate different perspectives on the same launch — the exec "why it matters," the customer value proposition, and the rep's reasons to believe.

  • Build and maintain the materials, processes, and playbooks the field needs.

  • Sit close to the field, and turn what you hear into recommendations for Product Marketing.

  • Analyze performance data to find where a launch is stalling, and flag risks early.

What We Look For

  • 6+ years of experience in go-to-market strategy, product marketing, revenue or sales operations, ideally in FinTech, SaaS, or another high-growth environment.

  • A track record of owning a go-to-market motion or product line end to end, rollout through adoption, within a defined scope.

  • You've been handed vague "go make this work" instructions, then built a solution that resonated with stakeholders and customers.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, PMM, Client Success, Sales, Analytics, Legal, or Pricing.

  • Comfort translating product and pricing strategy into practical, field-ready execution.

  • Solid analytical instincts: you use adoption and performance data to decide what to do next, not just to report what happened.

  • Clear, action-oriented writing and speaking.

  • You do your best work in ambiguity and move fast without waiting to be told the approach.

  • Familiarity with merchant, payments, or fintech ecosystems is a must-have.

Equity Grade - 6

Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

We are looking for a highly skilled, hands-on Technical Team Lead to lead the global build and technical integration of Full MVNO systems. In this role, you will lead a dedicated Build Team responsible for architecting, integrating, testing, and commissioning end-to-end Full MVNO capabilities across global markets.

Operating under a Build-to-Run model, you and your team will build new MVNO capabilities and host MNO integrations from the ground up, execute rigorous testing, and hand over stable, operational systems to a dedicated Run team after launch. This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Mobile Core networks across voice, VoLTE, data, and SMS, strong knowledge of telecommunications regulations, and experience leading engineering and QA teams.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead, mentor and manage a team of around five engineers and QA specialists, owning sprint planning, task allocation and technical reviews across concurrent global rollout streams.
  • Establish engineering best practices, integration templates, automated testing strategy and technical handover standards.
  • Lead technical integrations with host mobile network operators globally, across signalling, packet core, voice and messaging.
  • Own the architecture and setup of Full MVNO core components, from the subscriber database (HSS/HLR) through packet core, signalling routing and messaging platforms.
  • Direct implementation and troubleshooting across the signalling stack, including Diameter and SS7.
  • Own end-to-end service readiness across data, voice and SMS, covering session management, policy enforcement, data routing, VoLTE, legacy circuit-switched voice and international interconnects.
  • Design and validate mobile number portability routing in line with country-specific regulatory frameworks.
  • Own regulatory compliance for each market, covering lawful interception (ETSI ES 201 671 / TS 102 232, HI1/HI2/HI3) and emergency service routing such as e112, 911 and 999.
  • Partner with QA on integration test plans, stress testing and acceptance testing, then drive Operational Readiness Reviews and clean documented handovers to the 24/7 Run team after launch.

What You'll Bring:

  • 5+ years hands-on in mobile core networks and Full MVNO integrations.
  • 2+ years leading a team of engineers and/or QA specialists in an agile or delivery-focused environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of both packet core and voice core, including the subscriber database (HSS/HLR), policy and charging, VoLTE and legacy circuit-switched voice.
  • Expertise across the signalling stack, including Diameter, SS7 and SIP.
  • Experience with messaging architecture and SMS routing, including interworking with other operators.
  • Proven experience delivering mobile number portability and lawful interception solutions.
  • Strong delivery mindset across multiple concurrent rollout streams, with clear communication and the ability to produce documentation good enough to hand a system over on.

Nice to have

  • Automation experience: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible), containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes) or automated signalling test frameworks.
  • Hands-on with core MVNO vendors such as Nokia, Ericsson, Mavenir, Oracle Communications, Cisco, Summa Networks, NetNumber or XIUS.
  • Cloud-native or virtualised network functions on AWS, Azure, GCP or private cloud.
  • Degree in telecommunications engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or similar.

Why People Join Us

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

On-Call

Participating in our on-call rotation is a core expectation of this role. It's essential for maintaining 24/7 service reliability across our global operations, ensuring our systems remain resilient and our customers experience uninterrupted service, regardless of time zone or geography.

  • Paid Rotation: We offer standby fees + overtime pay.
  • Delayed Start: No on-call duties for your first 6 months.
  • Rest & Recovery: Guaranteed rest periods and flexible hours following night incidents.
  • Shared Load: Rotations are split (Weekdays vs. Weekends) to minimize fatigue.

Please refer to the On-Call Policy in the Airalo Handbook for full details:

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. raw.description:
About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

Support Torc’s Test Safety program by collaborating with product development, engineering, Safety and Regulatory and fleet operation teams to perform Operational Safety Analysis and monitor, assess, and improve the safe testing of Autonomous Driving System (ADS)-equipped heavy trucks.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive, Perform and Maintain Operational Safety Concept and operational safety relevant work products.

  • Develop and maintain Test Safety processes for software releases and public road testing.

  • Lead/perform safety risk assessments with internal stakeholders.

  • Develop and document Operational Safety plan, requirements and concept.

  • Partner with product management, design engineering, service, and maintenance to driver Operational Safety Design.

  • Support the development and maintenance of operational procedures related to testing autonomous vehicles safely.

  • Provide data analyses to maintain a safety case for Autonomous Vehicle platforms, including real-time safety support of operational testing.

  • Develop metrics to track Operational Safety of autonomous vehicle testing.

  • Evaluate safety results of tests and develop risk mitigation plans.

  • Support Torc accident and incident response process, mishap investigation, and corrective action plans.

  • Review engineering design specifications, test operations procedures, change proposals, deficiency reports, exceptions, and other requests for potential test safety impacts.

  • Support preparation of presentations, analyses, and reports for customer & Torc Safety Board meetings, program design reviews, and test readiness reviews.

  • Perform and contribute to safety & reliability analysis (e.g., FMEA, DFMEA, DFMEDA, FTA, STPA, etc.).

  • Support cross functional product development engineering teams to identify and close gaps to ensure component and system level safety compliance.

  • Review system technical specifications/requirements, system design documents, unit and system level software development, test plans, test reports

  • Coordinate and collaborate across stakeholders to ensure test safety is integral to all autonomous development testing and operations.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrates competences and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 4+ years of experience or;
  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering or related technical field plus demonstrates competences and technical proficiencies typically acquired through 0-3+ years of experience.

  • Knowledge of automotive, heavy duty trucks, or aerospace products and industries.

  • Professional experience in automotive and surface transportation safety industry.

  • Experience with or theoretical knowledge of Systems Engineering, Hazard and Risk Assessment (HARA), Design Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (DFMEA), Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) and/or Systems Theoretic Process Analysis (STPA).

  • Critical/logical thinking to identify problems and provide solutions to ensure efficiency, safety, and quality.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, able to identify root causes in complex integrated systems.

  • Experience in project management, vehicle program management, product development life cycle, and project planning.

  • Experience with requirements management tools (such as JAMA) and framework to document, review, and approve safety requirements.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and oral and written communication skills.

  • Detail oriented, reliable, and self-motivated.

  • Ability to work in an environment of ambiguity and ongoing change.

  • Ability to thrive in a face-paced environment with quickly changing business needs.

  • Ability to ethically handle sensitive and confidential information with impartiality and professionalism.

Bonus Points

  • Experience performing systematic and comprehensive assessments on the system architecture, integrated design, software, support equipment, and installation of the subsystems, and experiments to ensure that relevant safety requirements are met.

  • Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicle operations, or systems integration of complex electro-mechanical systems desired

  • Experience using ROS is preferred.

  • Programming experience in C++ and Python is desired.

  • Demonstrated safety engineering analyses.

  • Vehicle program support and root cause analysis for vehicle issues

  • Experience ensuring and auditing compliance.

  • ISO 26262, IEC 61508 and ISO 21448 Proficiency.

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r
Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer match
  • Flexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)
  • AD+D and Life Insurance

At Torc, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.
Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets. Pay is based on a number of factors and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.Torc's total compensation package will also include our corporate bonus and stock option plan. Dependent on the position offered, sign-on payments, relocation, and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Manager, Post Appeals will oversee the Unresponded team and lead the post-appeal response tracking function within Natera's Revenue Cycle Billing Operations. This role is responsible for overseeing a large remote team (offshore and onshore) focused on monitoring and driving resolution of appeals submitted to payers across all plan types. The Manager partners cross-functionally with Denials & Appeals, Technology, and operational leadership to determine solutions that will reduce backlog, maintain SLA compliance, and build scalable workflows that support the team's growing volume.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Unresponded team, including an offshore team of 124+ reps with supporting leadership, and onshore Analysts and Supervisor.

  • Monitor and drive resolution of all post-appeal payer responses across commercial and non-commercial plans, ensuring timely follow-up and accurate disposition of outstanding appeals

  • Identify backlog drivers and develop strategies to reduce aging unresponded appeals and bring the team within SLA targets

  • Partner with technology and systems teams to define, prioritize, and implement workflow improvements

  • Collaborate closely with the Denials & Appeals teams to ensure errors identified within the unresponded scope are escalated, documented, and fed back into the broader process

  • Manage performance of direct and indirect reports through goal-setting, productivity monitoring, coaching, and ongoing development

  • Build and refine standard operating procedures and workflows to sustain SLA compliance as volume scales

  • Serves as liaison between offshore leadership and onshore Natera staff to ensure alignment on priorities, processes, and performance expectations

  • Performs other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field or equivalent experience required

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in managing large teams within billing, denials management, or revenue cycle operations within a laboratory or healthcare setting

  • Demonstrated experience managing large, remote or offshore teams

  • Strong knowledge of commercial and non-commercial payer plans, appeal processes, and post-appeal response workflows

  • Familiarity with multiple payer portals required; experience with AMD preferred

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technology or systems teams to drive operational workflow improvements

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Deep understanding of the appeals lifecycle, including post-submission payer response tracking and resolution

  • Ability to analyze backlog data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable operational strategies

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across a large team structure

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with evolving workflows and systems

  • Effective communicator across all levels — offshore reps, onshore leadership, and technology stakeholders

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel); experience with billing platforms and payer portals strongly preferred

  • Knowledge of PHI handling requirements; this role regularly accesses PHI in both paper and electronic form

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

We’re here to drive tech-enabled change for property developers to shape the communities of the future! 🏗️🌍

We’re supercharging the entire development process by building cutting-edge technology for every stage of a property developer’s journey towards unlocking land 🏡🔑 90% of the top 200 global cities face a housing crisis - and it’s still too difficult for developers to build the places we need. To keep up with demand, the property industry needs to keep evolving…

And that’s where LandTech comes in💡 Since 2014, we’ve been leading the charge 🚀

Established by two co-founders passionate about solving a complex problem, our game-changing products have become the industry standard for site sourcing and assessment. Now, we’re a multi-million-pound powerhouse carving our path to international success! 🌎🔥

THE ROLE

Reporting to the VP of People, the People Advisor will act as a trusted right hand across the People function - helping ensure our people operations run brilliantly, managers are well-equipped, and support our people through every stage of the employee lifecycle in a remote-first business.

You’ll be the first point of contact for day-to-day people matters, taking ownership of employee relations, manager coaching, policy development, engagement and performance management. This role would suit someone dependable, proactive, and motivated by the opportunity to grow their career as a People professional in an industry leading technology company.

KEY ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Act as a trusted partner to the VP of People, providing dependable support across People priorities, strong follow-through on key actions, and proactive ownership of agreed workstreams.
  • Dependable first point of contact for employees and line managers on day-to-day people matters, providing timely, accurate advice on policies, procedures, and processes.
  • Own the operational heartbeat of the People function, ensuring employee lifecycle processes are smooth, accurate, compliant, and continuously improving.
  • Coach and upskill line managers to build their capability to lead their teams effectively, and handle people issues confidently and consistently.
  • Review, update, and help develop LandTech policies and documentation to keep them legally compliant, practical, and aligned with our values.
  • Manage employee relations casework end to end. Advise and coach managers through each stage, and use sound judgement to escalate to the VP of People where necessary.
  • Support recruitment and retention activity, including management of the candidate pipeline, advising managers on hiring, interviewing, and onboarding best practice.
  • Own the committed rhythm of cyclical people activities such as performance reviews, engagement surveys, and compensation and benefit reviews, supporting the VP of People on their effective delivery.
  • Use people data and case trends to identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to policies, processes, and manager capability.
  • Support and drive high-performance, engagement, wellbeing, and culture initiatives that embed our values across teams.
  • Bring curiosity, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset to how we support managers, employees, and the wider business.

KEY DELIVERABLES [3-6 months]

  • Build strong relationships across the business, becoming a trusted and dependable first point of contact for people queries.
  • Establish yourself as a reliable right hand to the VP of People, providing proactive support, strong follow-through, and ownership of key People priorities.
  • Get fully up to speed with our policies, processes, systems, and ways of working, identifying opportunities to simplify, improve, or strengthen them.
  • Take ownership of People operations and employee lifecycle processes, ensuring they run smoothly, accurately, and compliantly.
  • Confidently manage live employee relations casework, providing sound, timely, and risk-aware guidance to managers.
  • Use people data, case trends, and employee feedback to recommend practical improvements to policies, processes, and manager capability.
  • Own cyclical People activity, engagement, wellbeing, culture, and performance initiatives.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN

  • Working closely with the VP of People, you will have exposure to strategic People projects that help shape our culture, employee experience, manager capability, and ways of working.
  • Develop broad experience across employee relations, people operations, manager coaching, policy, engagement, performance, and culture.
  • Real ownership from day one, with the opportunity to improve how People processes, policies, and support are delivered.
  • A clear platform to grow your People career by becoming a trusted partner to managers, employees, and the wider business.
  • The opportunity to build confidence, judgement, and influence in a leading, remote-first SaaS business.

EDUCATION BACKGROUND & TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE

  • CIPD qualification (minimum Level 5), with a commitment to keeping employment law and best-practice knowledge current.
  • Solid working knowledge across the core HR disciplines: employee relations, performance management, and the wider employee lifecycle. Sufficient to advise managers independently on most day-to-day matters.
  • Strong, practical understanding of UK employment law and its application, able to interpret legislation and policy to give sound, risk-aware advice.
  • Experience handling employee relations casework (disciplinary, grievance, absence, capability), including preparing documentation and supporting or advising at hearings.
  • Sound understanding of people operations and HRIS platforms (ideally BambooHR), with the ability to oversee accurate, compliant employee lifecycle administration.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, and applying HR policies and procedures.
  • Confident using people data insights to spot trends and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong coaching, influencing, and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships and handle sensitive matters with discretion.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL

  • You’re highly dependable - people trust you to follow through, handle sensitive matters carefully, and keep things moving.

raw.description:
Email Art Director

Remote. Full-time. Player-coach.

Performance retention agency for 9-figure DTC brands. Email and SMS are the product. Design is not decoration on top of it. Campaigns have to look like the brand and still convert. The book spans fashion editorial, clean beauty, loud CPG, and luxury accessories. One house style will not work here.

Most email at this level is art directed by nobody. A strategist writes a brief, a designer restyles last month's module, and it ships. It converts fine and looks like everything else in the inbox.

You are the art director on every account. You set the world before anyone executes inside it.

What you'll own

  • The first emails for every new client. You design them yourself. You do not brief them out and hope.
  • The visual system for each brand: type, photography (crop, cutout, collage), color, merchandising, motion if it earns its place.
  • Design quality across the whole book of business. If a campaign looks like a Klaviyo template, a restyled module, or a social graphic dumped into an email, that is on you.
  • The graphic designers. Brief them, critique the work, raise the floor, and keep them shipping at the standard you set.
  • Campaign-level art direction for weekly sends, promos, and drops. Each drop should feel like a designed world, not a product grid with a new header.
  • Partnership with strategists and copywriters. You take a brief and make it look expensive. You push back when the brief will produce generic work.
  • Taste across categories. A fashion drop and a clean beauty campaign should not share a layout.

Why this seat and not an in-house one

In-house you art direct one brand and get very good at one voice. Here you get four or five live at once across categories that fight each other stylistically, and you get to keep your hands in the file. If you have been at one brand for three years and can feel your range narrowing, that is the reason to read this twice.

Hours

Core overlap is 9am to 5pm EST. LatAm applicants: Mexico City is EST minus 1, Bogotá is EST, Buenos Aires is EST plus 2. US and Canada applicants on PST, you are starting at 6am. Know that before you apply.

Requirements

    • You have art directed for an agency or brand at 9-figure ecommerce scale. Name the agency and the brands. "Worked with" logos you never designed for do not count.
    • An exceptional email book. Campaign art direction, not flow production. Custom display type, photography that is treated, merchandising that still looks designed. If the book is catalog, sale, and default type, do not apply.
    • You still design. This is not a Creative Director seat for someone who only critiques. The first work on a new client is yours.
    • You have led designers before. Small team is fine. You know how to brief, redline, and get better work out of other people without sanding it down to safe.
    • Mastery of Figma. Adobe is assumed. You can build for Klaviyo without designing like Klaviyo.
    • Range. Fashion, beauty, CPG, accessories. One aesthetic is a specialist. We need a lead.
    • Based in Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, the United States or Canada.
  • Send a portfolio link. Applications without one are not read.

Benefits

PTO

Performance Bonuses

Paid in USD

Fully remote, permanently

Familiarity with various types of cranes, including Overhead Gantry Cranes and Rail Mounted Gantry Cranes that are associated with these structures is a plus. Join Our Team as a Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate (0.35 FTE) - home based in Israel.

Interested in future opportunities with TFS HealthScience?

We are currently building a network of experienced Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associates for an anticipated ophthalmology project. While this position is not yet actively open for immediate recruitment / onboarding, we encourage interested candidates to apply and join our talent community. Once sponsor requirements are confirmed, our Talent Acquisition Team we will reach out to candidates whose experience best aligns with the project needs.

About this role

As part of our Ophthalmology team you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

The Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate is part of Clinical Development Services (CDS) within TFS HealthScience, will function operationally as a member of a Project Team and is responsible for the initiation, on-site and/or remote monitoring and close out of study sites during study conduct, according to company policies, SOPs and regulatory requirements.

The Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate will provide Unmasked Clinical Research Associate support for assigned clinical studies, including management of investigational product accountability, oversight of unblinded site activities, and monitoring of protocol compliance in accordance with study requirements and applicable regulations. The Freelance Senior Clinical Research Associate will collaborate with study teams, investigative sites and sponsors to ensure timely execution of study deliverables while maintaining the integrity of study blinding and data quality.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor on-site and remotely clinical trials in accordance with TFS and/or sponsor Standard Operating Procedures GCP and ICH guidelines and applicable regulatory regulations. Perform all required monitoring activities at the study sites to assess and ensure subjects safety, data integrity and quality.

  • Verify the protection of study participants by informed consent procedures and protocol requirements that follow appropriate regulations.

  • Review CRFs (electronic or paper) and subject source documentation for validity and accuracy

  • Verify proper management and accountability of Investigational Product

  • Timely reporting of actions taken during monitoring visits in Monitoring Visit Report including findings, corrective and preventive actions already taken and update applicable tracking systems, as required; escalate observed deficiencies and issues as appropriate.

  • Providing site with the listing of issues identified during monitoring visit and action items which will need to be addressed in a timely manner.

  • Timely delivering site documents to eTMF or paper TMF.

  • Verify that the Investigator's Site File (ISF) is maintained in accordance with GCP and ICH guidelines and local regulatory requirements.

  • Update CTMS and all other required by projects systems with accurate site level information

  • Participate in audit and/or inspection, it’s preparation and follow-up activities, as needed.

  • Order, ship, and reconcile clinical investigative supplies for study sites, if applicable.

  • May assist the Clinical Research Manager or Project Manager in certain aspects of project activities which may include:

  • project tracking,

  • monitoring plans,

  • Review of monitoring reports

  • CRA resources management within the project

  • May perform Assessment Site Visits (ASV) when requested.

  • May act as a mentor to CRAs.

  • May develop and implement therapeutic area training for other CRAs and project team members.

  • May participate in capabilities presentations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, preferably in life science or nursing; or equivalent

  • >5 years of independent on-site monitoring experience and at least 1 year experience as an unmasked monitor is required.

  • At least 1 year Ophthalmology, ideally within a retina indication (i.e. Age-related Macular Degeneration, Diabetic Macular Edema, Geographic Atrophy, RVO, BRVO, CRVO, etc.), experience is preferred.

  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

  • Understand basic medical terminology and science associated with the assigned drugs and therapeutic areas.

  • Possess the understanding of Good Clinical Practice regulations, ICH guidelines.

  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team matrix organization.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Fluent in English and local language

  • Excellent organizational skills

  • Technology savvy and good software and computer skills

  • Soft skills requirements: Self-awareness, resolute, flexibility, collaborative mindset, proactivity, analytic approach, and attention to detail, coach ability, motivated to take on new challenges, facilitation of discussion, diplomacy in difficult situations.

  • Ability to take the ownership of the assigned tasks.

  • Ability to manage complex or early phases studies.

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 60-80%, overnight and abroad, if applicable.

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 25 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a global CRO with the ultimate goal of ensuring patients’ safety and well-being, we provide biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies with tailored clinical development solutions. We currently operate in 17 countries across Europe, North America, Asia Pacific and the Middle East.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Flexibility and Passion are what make TFS Healthscience the successful company it is today. Our values shape our culture and work ethic. They reflect what we stand for and guide our organization.

Du bist kein Anfänger im Vertrieb.

Du weißt, wie man ein Gespräch eröffnet, wie man Interesse weckt, wie man Einwände auffängt und wie man einen Entscheider dazu bringt, den nächsten Schritt zu gehen.

Dann wollen wir dich kennenlernen.

Bei NETSHAKE bauen wir gerade unseren Vertrieb für einen Markt auf, der sich fundamental verändert: KI verändert, wie Menschen einkaufen – und damit, wie Unternehmen online sichtbar werden.

Menschen fragen nicht mehr nur Google, welchen Shop sie besuchen sollen. Sie fragen zunehmend KI.

Die KI empfiehlt. Die KI filtert. Die KI entscheidet mit.

Und genau dort positionieren wir unsere Kunden.

NETSHAKE verbindet 26 Jahre E-Commerce-Erfahrung mit KI. Wir sind Shopify Premier Partner, TÜV-zertifiziert und haben bereits über 1.600 E-Commerce-Projekte umgesetzt.

Wir verkaufen keine austauschbare Dienstleistung.

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, in der nächsten Generation des E-Commerce sichtbar zu bleiben.

Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Aufgaben

Du bist dafür verantwortlich, aus Kontakten echte Opportunities zu machen.

Du sprichst mit Unternehmern, Geschäftsführern und Entscheidern und schaffst es, innerhalb kurzer Zeit Relevanz aufzubauen.

  • AI-vorqualifizierte Leads aktiv ansprechen

  • aus jedem Gespräch lernen und deine Quote kontinuierlich steigern

Du bist der Türöffner.

Und ein guter Türöffner macht nicht einfach eine Tür auf.

Er sorgt dafür, dass der richtige Mensch hereinkommt.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen keine Telefonierer. Wir suchen Hunter.

Du solltest bereits Erfahrung im Opening und Setting mitbringen.

Noch wichtiger ist uns aber deine Haltung.

Du bist jemand, der:

Hunger hat.
Du willst Ergebnisse und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

Resilient ist.

Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus dem Takt.

Durchsetzungsstark ist.
Du bleibst dran und lässt dich nicht beim ersten Widerstand abwimmeln.

Professionell ist.
Du kannst mit Geschäftsführern und C-Level auf Augenhöhe sprechen.

Diszipliniert ist.
Du brauchst niemanden, der dich ständig antreibt.

Zahlen liebt.
Du weißt, wie viele Gespräche du führst, welche Quote du hast und wo du besser werden musst.

Feedback sucht.
Du willst nicht hören, dass du gut bist. Du willst wissen, wie du besser wirst.

Ehrgeizig ist.
Du willst in zwei Jahren nicht mehr dort stehen, wo du heute stehst.

Benefits

  • Fixum + ungedeckelte Provision

Wir wollen Leistung nicht mit einem Standardgehalt deckeln.

Du bekommst ein Fixum zum Start plus leistungsorientierte Provision.

Als Setter liegt das Einkommenspotenzial – abhängig von deiner Performance- bei 2.500 € bis 10.000 €.

Wer außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse liefert, soll auch außergewöhnlich verdienen können.

Kein künstliches Limit.

  • AI-vorqualifizierte Leads – keine wahllosen Listen, sondern relevante Kontakte mit echtem Potenzial.
  • Profi-Sales-Setup – Close CRM, Power Dialer und klare Prozesse.
  • Sales-Coaching aus der Praxis – direktes Training und Feedback von einem Vertriebsleiter mit über 50.000 eigenen Sales Calls.

  • Zukunftsmarkt KI & E-Commerce – du verkaufst ein Thema, das den Onlinehandel gerade grundlegend verändert.
  • 100 % Remote – arbeite von überall oder nutze unser Office in Business Bay, Dubai.
  • Performance-Kultur – klare KPIs, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung gesehen und belohnt wird.
  • Persönliche Entwicklung – Verantwortung, Feedback und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung statt Stillstand.
  • Langfristige Perspektive – Möglichkeit einer Festanstellung und internationaler Entwicklung innerhalb unserer Unternehmensstruktur.
  • Teamevents – gemeinsamer Erfolg wird gemeinsam gefeiert.

Du suchst einen Job? Dann gibt es einfachere.

Du willst aber Sales richtig lernen, deine Performance messen, mehr verdienen und dich weiterentwickeln?

Du willst nicht irgendeinen Remote-Job.

Du willst ein Umfeld, in dem Ehrgeiz etwas zählt.

Dann könnte das hier dein nächster Schritt sein.

Wir suchen keine Bewerber.

Wir suchen Hunter.

Hungrig. Resilient. Durchsetzungsstark. Professionell.

Mit Niveau. Mit Ehrgeiz. Mit dem Willen, zu gewinnen.

**Wenn du glaubst, dass du einer von ihnen bist: Bewirb dich.

**

NETSHAKE. Kein Limit im Kopf. Kein Limit im Einkommen. Komm ins Gewinnerteam.

raw.description:
VP, Growth and Sales: Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices

  • Location: United States, East Coast strongly preferred; remote with extensive travel
  • Reporting: Chief Business Officer, Healthcare and Life Sciences
  • Mandate: Scale an established robust platform towards 9 figures multi-million-dollar sales quota
  • Commercial focus: New logo acquisition and major new revenue creation, with selective strategic expansion

Company Overview:

Our client is a global technology services and consulting organization that combines industry expertise, digital engineering, cloud, data, enterprise platforms and business AI. The company operates across approximately 40 countries, employs more than 80,000 professionals and serves hundreds of major global enterprises. Its Healthcare and Life Sciences business is entering a deliberate scale phase built on strong domain capabilities, global delivery and established relationships across regulated industries.

The platform currently includes dedicated leaders for Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices. This newly created role will sit between those leaders and the Chief Business Officer, providing integrated commercial direction across the portfolio while keeping Life Sciences as the primary growth engine.

The mandate

  • Create and execute a unified growth strategy across Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices, with the majority of market attention, leadership energy and pipeline creation centered on Life Sciences.
  • Build a repeatable new logo engine and originate large, strategic opportunities. This is primarily a growth and sales leadership position, not a traditional account management role.
  • Help scale an existing combined business of approximately 9 figures multi-million dollar sales quota platform through organic growth, stronger market coverage, larger pursuits and sharper sector positioning.
  • Provide commercial leadership across three established sector businesses, align their go to market priorities and create one coherent executive story for clients, partners and the market.
  • Translate deep industry knowledge into board and C suite conversations, differentiated propositions and complex transformation programs that combine consulting, technology, engineering and managed services.

Sector priorities

Life Sciences, the primary focus

The successful executive will bring current, credible and commercially useful knowledge across pharma and biotech, CROs and CDMOs, consumer health and the broader life sciences value chain. Relevant areas include discovery and development, clinical trials, regulatory and quality, manufacturing and supply chain, commercial launch, patient services, data and AI, cloud modernization, enterprise applications and digital operating models.

Medical Devices and MedTech

The role will also support growth with device and diagnostics companies through connected products, software and platform engineering, product lifecycle services, intelligent validation, quality and regulatory assurance, smart manufacturing, supply chain transformation and digital health.

Healthcare

Relevant healthcare experience may span payers, providers, pharmacy benefit managers and HealthTech. Priority themes include patient and member experience, core platform modernization, interoperability, data and analytics, responsible AI, value based care, operational optimization and secure cloud native transformation.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the growth agenda. Set the commercial strategy, priority markets, target account architecture and investment choices required to achieve the portfolio ambition.
  • Win new logos. Personally lead executive access, pursuit strategy and closing for major new clients, while building a disciplined team based origination engine.
  • Shape large deals. Work with consulting, delivery, engineering, alliances and solution teams to convert industry problems into differentiated, outcome based propositions and multiyear programs.
  • Build market credibility. Represent the organization with senior industry executives, boards, partners and ecosystem leaders. Strengthen the external point of view on AI, digital engineering and regulated transformation.
  • Integrate three businesses. Align Life Sciences, Healthcare and Medical Devices leadership around a common growth plan without losing the specialist depth of each sector.
  • Run a rigorous pipeline. Establish clear qualification, account prioritization, forecasting, deal governance and conversion disciplines. Maintain visibility into revenue, margin, risk and resource needs.
  • Develop leadership capacity. Coach senior sales and sector leaders, raise standards for consultative selling and create a collaborative culture that connects front end growth with delivery excellence.
  • Expand selectively. Use existing relationships when they can unlock substantial new programs, but keep the role centered on new revenue rather than routine farming or account administration.

Required experience

  • Approximately 15 or more years of progressive enterprise sales, business leadership or market development experience, including significant responsibility in global technology services, digital engineering, consulting or a highly relevant enterprise product organization.
  • Predominantly Life Sciences experience, with current or recent responsibility for selling into pharmaceutical, biotech or adjacent life sciences clients.
  • Meaningful exposure to Healthcare and Medical Devices, whether through current responsibility or earlier leadership assignments.
  • A documented record of opening major new logos and building large new revenue streams. Candidates whose experience is primarily account farming will not match the central mandate.
  • Experience carrying or influencing a nine figure portfolio, or leading a comparably complex scale up involving multiple industry segments, large pursuits and global delivery teams.
  • Executive relationships and a relevant network across pharmaceutical, biotech, MedTech, payer, provider or HealthTech organizations.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This role focuses on CloudBlue, a HostPapa business that powers cloud commerce for many of the world’s largest service providers, including major Telcos, distributors, and MSPs. CloudBlue enables partners to monetize and manage cloud services and subscriptions at scale, combining the agility of a high-growth business with the backing of a global organization.

As the Senior Data Engineer, you will help design, build, and evolve CloudBlue’s data and analytics platform, with a strong focus on AI-driven capabilities. Our HostPapa team values diversity and inclusion. We have a friendly company culture built on trust and respect. With the acquisition of several companies into our product portfolio, we’re growing at an incredible rate and have ample opportunities for career growth.
