American Specialty Health Incorporated (ASH) is seeking an Associate Director-Speech Language Pathology to join our Health Services department.

The primary purpose of this position is to serve as a subject matter expert and clinical lead for speech language pathology from a clinical quality, clinical evidence, best practice and service delivery perspective to support ASH product development, operations, client interactions, and UM and Quality program activities. To perform and direct the activities of the Clinical Quality Evaluation Services and Audit Support for Speech Language Pathology. In this role, the Associate Director has direct responsibility for product development supporting the CHSO and Product Development Team as well direct responsibility for Medical Necessity Review and Clinical Quality Evaluation functions for Speech Language Pathology. The Associate Director will also support Provider Contracting and Communication through support of provider education and client meetings. This position works closely with Specialty Networks Operations to maintain MNR efficiencies and historic results. This position works independently with minimal supervision with clear understanding of when to escalate concerns and questions to management.

Salary Range

American Specialty Health complies with state and federal wage and hour laws and compensation depends upon candidate’s qualifications, education, skill set, years of experience, and internal equity. $112,500 Full-Time Annual Salary.


Remote Worker Guidelines

  • Remote Worker Guidelines: This position will be trained remotely and must be able to work from home (WFH) in a designated work area with company-provided technology equipment. This WFH position requires you have a stable connection to your Internet Service Provider with the ability to participate by video in online meetings over a reliable and consistent network. The internet connection must have a consistent 50 down/10 up Mbps minimum internet speed. 100 down/20 up is recommended to support higher quality video meetings.

Responsibilities

  • Develops, manages, evaluates, and is responsible for all activities within assigned scope of authority. Ensures accuracy and productivity achieves/exceeds Company standards.
    • Serves as subject matter expert and clinical lead for speech language pathology to support ASH product development, operations, client interactions, and UM and Quality program activities.
    • Performs CQE medical necessity review and supports ASH Committees and CPG development and implementation.
    • Directs the staff and ensures compliance with policy, accreditation, and regulatory requirements of these departments.
    • Oversees work-flow to subordinate staff.
    • Assists staff to resolve clinical issues.
    • Sets goals and objectives for the operation and staff.
    • Oversees initial and ongoing training of clinical staff.
    • Oversees audit process of clinical decision making within speech language pathology. .
    • Evaluates staffing needs making recommendations to Senior Vice President, Clinical Quality Evaluation and CHSO.
    • Recruits new staff members, as needed.
    • Evaluates staff performance, counsels and trains.
    • Initiates operational and clinical policies and procedures.
    • Reviews and approves expenses within scope of authority.
    • Primary interface with ASH internal staff and external consultants regarding speech and language pathology services administered by the company.
    • Supports customer audit and corrective action plan requirements.
    • Analyzes medical necessity review for quality and reporting purposes.
    • Participates as a member of the Specialty Health Policy Workgroup.
    • Communicates with customers on sensitive clinical issues.
    • Participates and works closely with the ARF Code workgroup facilitating appropriate ARF code development and implementation as indicated to support client audits.
    • Quality Improvement:
      • Participates on the Clinical Quality Team (CQT).
      • Support Key Processing Teams relating to clinical guidelines and clinical policy review and approval.
      • Assist staff, as appropriate, in supporting the resolution of clinical quality issues.
  • Supports clinical decision making related to various operational functions of other administrative departments to ensure efficient and effective teamwork is maintained within the organizations.
    • Represents Clinical Quality Evaluation to resolve clinical issues related to speech language pathology.
    • Provides input to developing organization goals, strategies, budgets, and other long- and short-term planning matters.
    • Develops and oversees maintenance of monthly and quarterly department reports.
    • Conducts education and training seminars, as needed.
    • Serves on committees and key process teams.
    • Supports sales and client implementation.
    • Supports Performance Standards and Clinical Performance Management reports and presentations.
    • Supports Company in clinically relevant legal matters.
    • Travels, as required to meetings and participate in sales demonstrations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

  • Professional clinical degree from an accredited speech language pathology college or university required.
  • 5 years of clinical practice experience or equivalent required.
  • 5 years of peer medical necessity review or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Oversight of speech language pathology staff or peer preferred.
  • Specific experience to include specialty health care operations, specialty health care Quality Committee participation, medical necessity case review, quality administration case review, clinical policy development preferred.
  • Proficient in MS Office with experience in conducting internet research required.
  • Must meet ASH clinical credentialing criteria required.
  • Subject Matter expertise for Speech Language Pathology from a clinical quality, clinical evidence, best practice and service delivery perspective.
  • In depth understanding of the ICD and CPT coding structures for speech language pathology and applicable clinical documentation.
  • Ability to identify trends, anticipate problems, and implement changes that improve use of time, resources, and process in order to meet quality and productivity goals.
  • Ability to apply and communicate evidence-based criteria and guidelines to specific review scenarios and describe clinical rationale consistently and effectively.
  • Project Management and Oversight Capabilities: assessing the scope of the project, identifying appropriate steps and milestones, effectively delegating and/or overseeing the delegation of tasks, setting goals and monitoring results, and recognizing barriers and finding solutions to ensure that all timelines are met.
  • Ability to present a range of options and make specific recommendations to fully address customer’s unique needs and desired results.
  • Ability to work with clients during clinical audits, communicate respectfully and with a high degree of knowledge on audit issues, and find solutions and resolution to audit issues.
  • Strong leadership qualities and the capacity to supervise professional staff.
  • Ability to set a standard of excellence as a role model, take specific steps to set goals, motivate staff, resolve conflicts, and acknowledge contributions; ability to work cooperatively with Leadership and staff to develop and manage staff schedules, balance workloads, and resolve conflicts in task prioritization.
  • Ability to assess staff skills / knowledge and communicate training opportunities to supervisors.
  • A current, unrestricted license to practice speech language pathology (while most states only require licensure in one state in the United States for medical necessity review, some states may require state specific licensure) required.
  • Employees must maintain a current, unrestricted license to practice and must be in good standing with all judicial and governing bodies (as required).

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to interact in a positive, respectful manner and establish and maintain cooperative working relationships.
  • Ability to display excellent customer service to meet the needs and expectations of both internal and external customers.
  • Excellent listening and interpersonal communication skills to identify critical core competencies based on success factors and organizational environment.
  • Ability to effectively organize, prioritize, multi-task and manage time.
  • Demonstrated accuracy and productivity in a changing environment with constant interruptions.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze information, problems, issues, situations, and procedures to develop effective solutions.
  • Ability to exercise strict confidentiality in all matters.

Mobility

  • Primarily sedentary, able to sit for long periods of time.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to see, speak, and hear other personnel and/or objects. Ability to communicate both in verbal and written form. Ability to travel within and around the facility or Work from Home (WFH) environment. Capable of using a telephone, computer keyboard, and mouse. Ability to lift up to 10 lbs.

Environmental Conditions

  • Work-from-home (WFH) environment.

COMPANY PROFILE

Great Minds, a mission driven Public Benefit Corporation, brings teachers and scholars together to craft exemplary instructional materials that inspire joy in teaching and learning. Our English curriculum, Wit & Wisdom®, Eureka Math™ and PhD Science™, all support teachers as they take students beyond rote learning to provide a deeper, more complete understanding of the humanities, mathematics, and the sciences. Founded in 2007, Great Minds now employs more than 1,000 people.

For additional information please visit:


OUR MARKET POSITION

Great Minds’ Eureka Math is the most widely used curriculum in the history of American education. It enjoys an unrivaled 40+ net promoter score. Eureka and its sister products, Wit & Wisdom English and PhD Science, embrace much higher expectations for all students and all teachers. In a market dominated by scripted, procedural materials that drive expectations down, Great Minds produces curricula that celebrate knowledge, respect the craft of teaching, and acknowledge the true capabilities of students.


Job Purpose

As a Pre-Sales Product Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in pre-sales strategy, helping sales showcase the value of Great Minds' curricula. Working alongside our Sales and Success Go-to-Market teams, you will create and deliver sales presentations and pilot trainings and support, tailoring content to address regional and district-specific needs.

This role is an exceptional opportunity for skilled teachers, instructional coaches, or pre-sales specialists who are experienced in implementing a high-quality curriculum, to contribute to Great Minds’ organizational mission to ensure all students have access to a high-quality, knowledge-based education.

Reports To

Manager, Pre-Sales Product Specialists


Responsibilities

  • Deliver compelling, market-driven sales presentations that effectively communicate the value of Great Minds' curricula.

  • Collaborate with field sales team members (RSMs, ASDs, ARs) to customize presentations based on regional and account-specific strategies.

  • Partner with ASMs in pre-sales customer conversations exploring solutions opportunities and pilot options.

  • Deliver persuasive sales presentations and support pre-sales efforts, including strategy development, training, and preparation activities.

  • Facilitate pilot training sessions for educators and provide ongoing support to ensure successful pilot implementation aligned with account strategies.

  • Demonstrate deep knowledge of Great Minds' products and effectively connect them to educational trends, district priorities, and instructional best practices.

  • Collaborate effectively with internal sales teams while also taking initiative and working independently.

  • Stay current on educational trends, priorities, and pedagogy to inform strategic sales initiatives and client interactions.

  • Deliver live pre-sales webinars that are customized to district needs

  • Handle customer questions and overcome objections

  • Utilize knowledge of competitors products to better position Great Minds products

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of experience teaching, coaching, or pre-sales support

  • Experience working in educational sales or curriculum implementation

  • Proficiency with or alignment to Great Minds instructional design and pedagogy

  • Engaging presentation and communication skills

  • Deep understanding of educational curricula and instructional strategies

  • Ability to build rapport with educators and stakeholders at all levels

  • Strong organizational habits necessary for successful goal setting, project management, collective decision making, deadline execution, and record keeping

  • Ability to make solutions-oriented decisions through flexible thinking in an ambiguous, fast-paced entrepreneurial environment

  • Digital literacy, including Microsoft Office, Zoom, Slack and PowerPoint

Attributes

  • Passion for and commitment to the importance of high-quality, knowledge-rich curriculum

  • Commitment to high standards, instructional quality, and continuous improvement for oneself and others

  • Receptivity to feedback with a focus on reflective practice

  • Highly collaborative with the ability to consistently exhibit diplomacy, tact, and integrity

  • Appreciation for the challenges and victories faced everyday by educators and their leaders working toward improving student learning outcomes

  • Empathy, curiosity, and the desire to continually grow as a learner

  • Deep belief that every child is capable of greatness

Travel

  • The Pre-Sales Product Specialist may travel up to 80% of the time during peak sales times (Aug-Nov; Jan – May).

  • Based on the regional needs across Great Minds, occasional travel beyond this region is possible.

  • A valid driver’s license and willingness to fly and drive are required for this position. Must reside near a major airport.

Bachelor's degree

Remote (Preferred Location: Oregon, Washington, California or adjacent states)

About the Brand & Communications team
Brand and Communications shapes how the world sees Affirm, and how Affirm chooses to be seen. That means showing up where perception takes shape: in culture and press, across Affirm's owned and paid channels, and within the company. We hold a high standard for craft and clarity, and we work to make Affirm a brand people understand, trust, and are proud to choose.

About the Role
We're looking for a Brand Manager to turn business priorities and consumer insight into campaigns that shift perception and drive measurable demand. You’ll own campaign strategy from brief through launch and retros, aligning partners, sharpening priorities, and ensuring every expression builds a more distinctive, trusted and effective Affirm brand.

What You’ll Do

  • Own campaign strategy and architecture for priority brand and partner moments, including co-marketing projects with key merchants and ongoing merchant and promotional campaigns outside the major seasonal moments. Translate business goals, audience insight, and brand strategy into briefs and recommendations that shape how Affirm invests in these moments, not just how individual campaigns execute.

  • Drive early strategic thinking and lead brief development for partner campaigns, shaping how Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Creative, Social, Paid, and Comms work together on audience, narrative, channel roles, and definition of success. Advise these teams on tradeoffs and complex calls, and review creative to ensure execution teams have what they need to build and ship excellent work.

  • Set campaign GTM strategy and investment priorities across brand and partner moments, determining how Brand Operations resources timelines and workflow and how channel leads allocate budget.

  • Build a learning culture. Define what's working across campaigns and turn it into reusable frameworks and standards that make every future effort stronger.

  • Own brand measurement and reporting in partnership with paid and analyst functions, both for brand overall and campaign by campaign. Maintain the integrity of the brand health tracker, hold execution partners accountable to the brief, and give leadership a clear, recurring read on what's working and what needs to change.

What We Look For

  • You have 8-10 years in brand marketing, integrated marketing, or a closely related discipline, with experience managing full campaigns from strategy to launch, ideally at both an agency and in-house teams.

  • As a natural creative thinker and problem solver yourself, you know how to partner and get strong creative out of a team. You've briefed and run creative work that landed sharp, on strategy, on budget and on time.

  • You have a track record of building brand awareness, equity, and differentiation through data and consumer insight, and can evaluate performance against business KPIs.

  • You're comfortable operating in a complex, matrixed marketing organization, and you’re capable of building alignment across cross-functional partners through influence.

  • You use data to develop and articulate a clear point of view, while staying collaborative and open to new information changing your mind.

  • Bonus. Experience with extending campaigns to global markets, and working in fintech, financial services, or another trust-sensitive category is a plus.

Pay Grade - L
Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $165,000 - $225,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $146,000 - $206,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced ETL Developer to design, develop, and optimize enterprise-scale data integration solutions supporting business intelligence, analytics, regulatory reporting, and cloud data modernization initiatives. This role focuses on building high-performance ETL pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse operational systems into enterprise data warehouses and cloud-based analytics platforms.
You will collaborate with data architects, data engineers, business analysts, cloud engineers, and BI developers to develop scalable data integration frameworks, automate complex workflows, and ensure the delivery of high-quality, trusted data across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong ETL development expertise with advanced SQL skills, cloud data platform experience, and a deep understanding of data warehousing and enterprise data governance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ETL/ELT pipelines for large-scale data integration projects.
  • Build scalable data ingestion workflows that extract data from relational databases, cloud applications, APIs, flat files, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop transformation logic for cleansing, standardizing, validating, and enriching large datasets.
  • Design and optimize batch and near real-time data processing pipelines supporting business-critical reporting and analytics.
  • Implement Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), Change Data Capture (CDC), incremental loading strategies, and data reconciliation processes.
  • Develop reusable ETL frameworks, metadata-driven workflows, and parameterized jobs to improve maintainability.
  • Perform source-to-target mapping, data profiling, and data quality analysis during project implementation.
  • Optimize ETL job performance by improving SQL queries, partitioning strategies, indexing, and parallel processing.
  • Monitor ETL workflows, troubleshoot production failures, and implement proactive alerting and recovery mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers to migrate legacy ETL workloads to Azure or AWS cloud platforms.
  • Participate in data architecture discussions, code reviews, deployment planning, and production support.
  • Ensure data security, governance, auditability, and regulatory compliance across enterprise data pipelines.

  • Strong hands-on experience with ETL platforms such as Informatica PowerCenter, SSIS, Talend, IBM DataStage, or Pentaho.
  • Advanced SQL development skills with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Teradata.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases, dimensional modeling, star schema, snowflake schema, and data warehousing principles.
  • Experience designing ETL workflows involving complex transformations, joins, aggregations, lookups, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Change Data Capture (CDC), Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 1 & Type 2), and incremental loading techniques.
  • Experience working with cloud data platforms including Azure Data Factory (ADF), AWS Glue, or Google Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Experience integrating structured and semi-structured data formats including JSON, XML, CSV, Parquet, and Avro.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Shell scripting for ETL automation.
  • Experience scheduling workflows using Control-M, Autosys, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or enterprise schedulers.
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or other CI/CD tools for ETL deployments.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and ETL performance tuning skills.
  • Experience working with Agile Scrum teams and enterprise SDLC processes.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses including Snowflake, Azure Synapse Analytics, Amazon Redshift, or Google BigQuery.
  • Knowledge of Apache Spark, Databricks, PySpark, or distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Experience implementing enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) and Data Quality solutions.
  • Familiarity with streaming technologies including Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hub, or Amazon Kinesis.
  • Experience developing metadata-driven ETL frameworks and reusable integration components.
  • Knowledge of Data Vault 2.0 architecture and modern data lakehouse concepts.
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices for data engineering and automated ETL deployments.
  • Experience with BI platforms including Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik for downstream reporting integration.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, lineage, cataloging, and regulatory compliance.
  • Cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, Snowflake, or Informatica are highly desirable.

Project Environment

You will be joining an enterprise data engineering team responsible for modernizing data integration and analytics platforms supporting multiple business units across financial services, healthcare, insurance, and retail industries. Current initiatives include:
  • Enterprise data warehouse modernization to Snowflake and Azure Synapse
  • Cloud-based ETL migration from legacy on-premises platforms

  • Data Lake and Lakehouse architecture implementation

raw.description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 15,000 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 500 staff with an intact startup mindset.

We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia.

Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Requirements

We are looking for an Accountant that is excited about the below Mission and Outcomes.

Mission: As an Accountant in our Australia team, your mission is to deliver accurate BAS lodgements, maintain clean financial records, and provide clients with clear, actionable financial insights. We’re looking for an excellent communicator who thrives on being the go-to person for clients’ accounting needs, offering support, clarity, and confidence every step of the way.

Outcomes:

    • Prepare and lodge accurate Business Activity Statements (BAS) and Instalment Activity Statements (IAS), ensuring GST and payroll liabilities are reconciled and compliant with ATO regulations.
    • Maintain accurate financial records and full sets of accounts across a portfolio of clients, using cloud systems like Xero and Dext, including fixed asset management, journals, and reporting.
    • Oversee accounts payable and receivable processes, ensuring timely invoicing, collections, payments, and reconciliation of supplier/client accounts.
    • Collaborate with bookkeeping and tax teams to ensure accuracy of transaction recording, ledger integrity, and smooth financial operations.
    • Assist in preparing monthly management accounts and financial reports, offering clients clear insights to support decision-making.
    • Provide payroll support and maintain strong communication with clients, acting as their go-to advisor for day-to-day accounting needs and ensuring adherence to Australian regulatory standards.
    • Manage the client relationship from end to end, providing answers and guidance to Australian SME owners. You will be communicating directly with the clients.

To do this, you will have a minimum of 3 years experience as an Accountant within Australian accounting, with a solid experience of client relationship management and outstanding communication (both verbal & written). Experience preparing corporate tax returns will be a major plus.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Data driven: We are a data rich business with ~15,000 small customers. Each decision we make can impact many more people than we realise - so it’s critical that we use sound data to support our strategies and review the success of our initiatives.

Can have tough conversations in a positive way: It’s not a matter of if, but when difficult interpersonal situations arise. Disagreement, conflict and disappointment are a given in a fast moving business where people care about their work. People that proactively have tough conversations with kindness build empathy, trust and great working relationships.

Tech + services savvy: We are a tech-enabled services business, automating traditional, manual processes and delighting customers while doing so. You will thrive as someone who understands and is excited by the challenges and opportunities of utilising software to scale a business.

Problem Solving: You’ll need to be able to think on your feet as this role requires you to identify, diagnose, and resolve production issues quickly, reducing downtime. You will leverage your strong infrastructure and development skills in post-incident reviews to find the underlying cause of failures and prevent future incidents.

Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

Analytical Mindset: You have a keen eye for detail and a methodical approach to dissecting problems. You excel at analysing complex systems and processes to identify weaknesses and inefficiencies, and your ability to evaluate multiple scenarios enables you to devise the best testing strategies. You apply data-driven decisions to enhance testing coverage and performance metrics, ensuring the highest standards of software quality.

Collaboration-Driven: You thrive in a cross-functional team environment, working closely with developers, product managers, and operations teams to ensure alignment on requirements and testing goals. You communicate effectively, advocate for quality throughout the development process, and proactively address potential issues before they arise, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for delivering exceptional software.

AI-ready and curious: Sleekbooks already utilises AI capabilities, but there are many more applications to be found and incorporated. We want the candidate to be able to identify additional AI-led applications and be able to ascertain the practicalities of those solutions

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the below interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

Whether the interviews are held over video call or in person will depend on your location and the role.

Case study

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager, where they will give you some real-life challenges that this role faces, and will ask for your approach to solving them.

Career deep dive

A ~60 minute chat with the Hiring Manager. They’ll discuss your last 1-2 roles to understand your experience in more detail.

Behavioural fit assessment

A ~60 minute chat with a member of the HR or leadership team, where they will dive into some of your recent work situations to understand how you think and work.

Offer + reference interviews

We’ll make a non-binding offer verbally or over email, followed by a couple of short phone or video calls with references that you provide to us.

+++++

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role.

This may include using external vendors to verify the below:

- Your education

- Any criminal history

- Any political exposure

  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

    • We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

    By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at sleek.com.

    Benefits

    Some other great things about working at Sleek…

    Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

    Flexibility: You’ll be able to work from home. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

    Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

    Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

    Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

We are looking for a Senior Data Modeller to join a data transformation project focused on designing robust, scalable and business-aligned data models. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Data Vault 2.0, including Business Vault, as well as Kimball Star Schema Data Mart modelling.

You will work closely with data architects, data engineers, business analysts and stakeholders to translate business requirements into high-quality data models that support analytical, reporting and decision-making needs. The role is especially suited to someone with solid technical judgement, experience in complex data environments and the ability to define modelling standards and best practices.

What you will do:

  • Design and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models for analytical platforms.
  • Build and validate Data Vault 2.0 models, including hubs, links, satellites and related modelling patterns.
  • Design and document Business Vault structures to support business rules, derived data, calculations and historisation.
  • Create Kimball Star Schema Data Marts, including facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions and reporting-ready structures.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, traceable and reusable data models.
  • Collaborate with data architects, data engineers, business analysts and reporting teams to align modelling decisions with platform and business needs.
  • Use modelling tools such as Lucidchart to document and communicate data models clearly.
  • Support data lineage, traceability, maintainability and governance across the data model lifecycle.
  • Review existing models and propose improvements based on performance, scalability, usability and data quality considerations.
  • Contribute senior modelling expertise, best practices and technical guidance within the delivery team.

Required:

  • C1 English proficiency
  • Senior-level experience as a Data Modeller
  • Strong hands-on experience with Data Vault 2.0 methodology.
  • Experience designing Business Vault components and understanding how business rules are represented in Data Vault.
  • Solid experience with Kimball Star Schema Data Mart modelling.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling and analytical data structures.
  • Ability to design hubs, links, satellites, dimensions, facts and related model components.
  • Experience translating business requirements into conceptual, logical and physical data models.
  • Experience documenting models using Lucidchart or similar modelling tools.
  • Strong communication skills to explain modelling decisions to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work autonomously in complex data environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in banking, financial services or highly regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data lakes, lakehouse architectures or cloud-based data warehouses.
  • Knowledge of data governance, lineage, metadata management and model documentation standards.
  • Familiarity with SQL and data profiling to validate modelling assumptions.
  • Experience working with BI, reporting or analytics teams.
  • Experience in Agile delivery environments.
  • Previous experience defining modelling standards or mentoring other data professionals.

What do we offer you?

  • Full-time contract
  • Remote within Spain Time zone.
  • Training and career development.
  • Benefits and perks such as private medical insurance, life insurance, Language lessons, etc
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

If you are passionate about data, development & tech, we want to meet you !

This is a remote position.

Strengthen cloud, application, and AI security by embedding practical controls across infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and incident workflows.

Organization: A confidential client; further details will be shared with shortlisted candidates, subject to client confidentiality requirements
Location: Remote - open to candidates in Egypt, Jordan, and other countries nearshore to the client's operating region
Role Type: Full-time | Consultant/contractor | Fixed-term project (6-8 months)
Reports to: To be confirmed
The opportunity
Our client is looking for a Middle+ Security Engineer to assess and reduce security risk across AWS infrastructure, application delivery, containers, and LLM/AI integrations. In this role, you will combine hands-on security engineering with automation, vulnerability remediation, and cross-functional technical review.
About the organization
Our client is a UAE-based HRTech scale-up transforming workplace operations across HR, Payroll, Finance, and Insurance in the MENA region. It helps employers and employees manage the full workplace lifecycle through a unified platform.

What you will do
  • Conduct threat modeling and security reviews for cloud infrastructure and LLM/AI integrations.
  • Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tools directly into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Harden AWS environments, Infrastructure as Code scripts, and Kubernetes workloads and containers.
  • Automate repetitive security tasks, alerting, and incident-response workflows using custom scripts.
  • Triage, investigate, and remediate vulnerabilities identified through automated scans and Bug Bounty programs.

What you bring

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, or a related role.
  • Scripting proficiency in Python, Go, or Ruby.
  • Deep hands-on experience with AWS cloud security services (IAM, VPC, GuardDuty, WAF, Inspector).
  • Practical experience with AppSec tooling (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, or SonarQube).
  • Experience with container and orchestration security controls (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) security reviews (Terraform or CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, RAG architectures, API security).

How the engagement works

Contracting party: You will contract directly with Apricot, which will manage contracting, invoicing/payroll, payments, and administrative support. Day to day, you will work closely with the client team and follow the agreed scope, deliverables, and security requirements.

You are expected to provide your own laptop and basic equipment, maintain reliable connectivity and a secure working environment, and follow required security controls, including two-factor authentication.

Planned check-ins are at month 1 to see how the engagement is working and help address issues, given the shorter 6–8 month duration.

About Apricot

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

Executive Briefing Centers (EBC) serve as locations where we engage customers and partners to expand their insight into NVIDIA’s solutions and promote strategic alignment. This role plays a key part in ensuring we have a solid platform featuring the necessary automations, integrations, and operational stability to support the full program. We are hiring a systems-focused Program Manager to manage BriefingSource administration, Salesforce reporting and integration, metrics strategy, data quality, workflow enablement, and AI adoption for NVIDIA's global EBC Program. If you are detail-oriented, analytical, and driven by developing scalable processes for a fast paced global program, this opportunity is a great fit.

  • Define and maintain EBC program metrics across operational health, survey performance, partner activation, pipeline influence, and program outcomes.

  • Direct hands-on BriefingSource experience, including administration, reporting, data quality, field configuration, workflow support, vendor concern management, and issue resolution.

raw.excerpt: Das erwartet DichBei Caspar Health entwickelst Du die zentrale digitale Arbeitsumgebung für Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams weiter.
raw.description:
Das erwartet Dich

Bei Caspar Health entwickelst Du die zentrale digitale Arbeitsumgebung für Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams weiter. Dein Auftrag ist klar. Klinische Prozesse sollen einfacher, schneller und sicherer werden, damit Fachkräfte mehr Zeit für die Behandlung ihrer Patient*innen haben.

Unser HCP-Produkt verbindet Patientenbetreuung, Therapieplanung und klinische Abläufe. Es wird bereits von Therapeut*innen und Klinikteams genutzt und soll zu ihrer zentralen Arbeitsumgebung werden. Du identifizierst die größten Engpässe in diesen Abläufen und verbesserst sie so, dass Zeitaufwand sinkt, die Nutzung steigt und die Versorgungsqualität erhalten oder verbessert wird.

Als Senior Product Manager verantwortest Du Produktstrategie, Discovery, Priorisierung und messbare Outcomes für diesen Bereich. Du berichtest direkt an den CPO und führst ein cross-funktionales Squad fachlich durch klare Ziele und Entscheidungen. Wir suchen keinen Backlog-Verwalter oder Ticket-Schubser. Du verantwortest Probleme und Outcomes. Roadmap, Backlog und Delivery sind für Dich Mittel, um messbare Verbesserungen zu erreichen.

Deine Herausforderungen

  • End-to-End Produktverantwortung: Als Product Manager für das HCP-Produkt entwickelst du Vision, Strategie und Roadmap; Dabei priorisierst du zwischen Kundennutzen, Versorgungsqualität, technischer Machbarkeit und wirtschaftlichem Beitrag und machst Zielkonflikte früh sichtbar
  • AI-native Produktentwicklung: AI (Skills, Agents) setzt du gezielt dort ein, wo Research, Datenanalyse, Prototyping oder Delivery nachweisbar beschleunigt werden; Entscheidend sind dabei die Qualität der Entscheidungen und die Geschwindigkeit des Lernens – nicht das verwendete Werkzeug
  • Nutzer- und Domänennähe: Regelmäßig arbeitest du mit Therapeut*innen unserer Caspar Clinic sowie externer Kliniken zusammen; Ein- bis zweimal pro Quartal beobachtest du Abläufe vor Ort und übersetzt diese Erkenntnisse gemeinsam mit Produktdaten in priorisierte Probleme und überprüfbare Hypothesen
  • Hands-on AI-Prototyping & Codebase: Eigenständig entwickelst du Prototypen, um kritische Annahmen früh zu testen. Technische Konzepte verstehst du sicher, arbeitest mit Entwickler*innen auf Augenhöhe und bringst bei passenden Aufgaben auch selbst Änderungen live
  • Product Craft & Squad-Führung: Dem Squad gibst du ein klares Problem, ein messbares Ziel und den nötigen Kontext; Schwierige Entscheidungen moderierst du souverän, priorisierst konsequent und sorgst dafür, dass das Team Wirkung statt Output optimiert
  • Messbarer Impact: Noch vor der Umsetzung definierst du, woran Erfolg erkennbar ist; Dabei misst du unter anderem Zeitaufwand, erfolgreiche Nutzung zentraler Abläufe, Nutzerzufriedenheit und wirtschaftlichen Beitrag – Qualität und Sicherheit der Versorgung bleiben dabei feste Leitplanken

Dein Profil

  • Produkt-Erfolgsbilanz: Du hast ein komplexes B2B- oder SaaS-Produkt end-to-end verantwortet und kannst deinen Beitrag anhand konkreter Ergebnisse belegen; Neue Produkte oder größere Produktbereiche hast du aufgebaut, weiterentwickelt oder neu ausgerichtet
  • AI-native Builder-Skills: AI und LLMs nutzt du praktisch für Research, Analyse oder Prototyping und kannst zeigen, wie du damit Lern- oder Delivery-Zyklen verkürzt hast; Mit technischen Entwicklungsabläufen bist du vertraut; Erfahrung mit GitHub und Pull Requests ist von Vorteil
  • Kommunikations- & Moderationsstärke: Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du Fachpersonal und Tech-Teams klar und adressatengerecht; Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab
  • Autonomie & High-Performance: Themen treibst du eigenständig voran, triffst Entscheidungen in deinem Verantwortungsbereich und machst Risiken früh sichtbar; Unterstützung holst du dir rechtzeitig, bevor Abhängigkeiten oder ungeklärte Entscheidungen den Fortschritt gefährden
  • Pragmatische Evidenz- & Datennähe: Qualitative Discovery verbindest du mit Produkt- und Geschäftsdaten; Du formulierst überprüfbare Hypothesen, kennst die Grenzen deiner Evidenz und passt Vorhaben anhand neuer Erkenntnisse an – oder stoppst sie konsequent
  • Unternehmerisches Mindset: Mit einem ausgeprägten Business Sense verbindest du Nutzerbedürfnisse, technische Machbarkeit und kommerziellen Erfolg zu überzeugenden Produktentscheidungen

Warum Caspar Health?

  • Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands
  • Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top
  • Genug Zeit zum erholen – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr
  • Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen & Coaching, passend zu deinen Potentialen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit: kein Mikromanagement – wir stellen Expert*innen ein, die wissen was sie tun #MakeAnImpact!
  • Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!
  • Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!
  • Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch

Was uns als Team ausmacht

  • Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag
  • Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur
  • Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft
  • Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Sr. Claims Specialist, Professional Liability | Medical Malpractice | Long Term Care

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: To analyze complex or technically difficult medical malpractice claims including long term care facilities; to provide resolution of highly complex nature and/or severe injury claims; to coordinate case management within Company standards, industry best practices and specific client service requirements; and to manage the total claim costs while providing high levels of customer service.

ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE?

We are seeking experienced professionals to manage complex medical malpractice claims involving severe injury and high exposure. Ideal candidates demonstrate strong analytical and negotiation skills, exercise sound judgment, and are committed to delivering timely, cost‑effective claim resolutions while maintaining a high level of customer service.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE:

  • Analyzes and processes complex or technically difficult medical malpractice claims by investigating and gathering information to determine the exposure on the claim; manages claims through well-developed action plans to an appropriate and timely resolution.

  • Conducts or assigns full investigation and provides report of investigation pertaining to new events, claims and legal actions.

  • Calculates and assigns timely and appropriate reserves to claims; monitors reserve adequacy throughout claim life.

  • Recommends settlement strategies; brings structured settlement proposals as necessary to maximize settlement.

  • Coordinates legal defense by assigning attorney, coordinating support for investigation, and reviewing attorney invoices; monitors counsel for compliance with client guidelines.

  • Uses appropriate cost containment techniques including strategic vendor partnerships to reduce overall claim cost for our clients.

  • Identifies and investigates for possible fraud, subrogation, contribution, recovery, and case management opportunities to reduce total claim cost.

  • Represents Company in depositions, mediations, and trial monitoring as needed.

  • Communicates claim activity and processing with the client; maintains professional client relationships.

  • Ensures claim files are properly documented and claims coding is correct.

  • Refers cases as appropriate to supervisor and management.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Supports the organization's quality program(s).

QUALIFICATIONS

Education & Licensing: 6 years of claims management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred. Licenses as required.

  • Professional certification as applicable to line of business preferred.

Work environment requirements include –

Physical: Computer keyboarding

Auditory/visual: Hearing, vision and talking
Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgement and discretion; ability to meet deadlines.
